items.title: 叡揚攜手Mend.io 拓AI資安版圖
items.title_en: Ruiyang Partners with Mend.io to Expand AI Cybersecurity Portfolio
paras: 軟體服務商叡揚(6752-TW)公布8月合併營收1.75億元，月減1.61%，年增11.4%，前8月合併營收13.41億元，年增5.66%，叡揚看準AI發展帶動的資安需求，也宣布引進國際資安品牌Mend.io 「源碼掃描」解決方案，增添營運新動能。
叡揚表示，「源碼掃描」解決方案，是為協助企業因應日益複雜的地雲架構和AI 資安挑戰，可支援純地端與混合部署，確保機敏資料不出境，更具備「精準過濾假警報(Reachability) 」、「AI 與軟體供應鏈資產盤點(SBOM / AI-BOM)」以及「AI 輔助即時修復(Shift-Left) 」等核心優勢，也能搭配清楚的計費邏輯與透明的統計數字來管控預算。
叡揚強調，透過 Mend.io 的先進防護結合叡揚 40 年深厚的在地技術團隊，可協助企業在兼顧合規、成本與效率下，全面強化數位韌性。
而在 ESG 碳盤查業務方面，叡揚說明，業績看漲、成效顯著，除了有累積多年的上市(櫃)公司續約客戶，近期再增添上市跨國物流服務業嘉里大榮採用旗下Vital NetZero 零碳雲系統，以加速旗下上百處營業據點碳盤查作業。
而叡揚接續推出 Vital ESG 永續指標管理，協助上市櫃公司內部方便擺放執行過程和結果，也方便跟顧問公司協同互動提升效率，有效整合並管理公司及供應鏈上下游的永續資訊揭露，銜接永續報告書編製，開啟永續e化治理新時代與新商機。
paras_en: Software service provider Ruiyang (6752-TW) reported August consolidated revenue of NT$175 million, down 1.61% month‑over‑month but up 11.4% year‑over‑year. For the first eight months, consolidated revenue reached NT$1.341 billion, a 5.66% annual increase. Spotting growing cybersecurity demand driven by AI, Ruiyang also announced the adoption of the international security brand Mend.io’s “source‑code scanning” solution to add new operational momentum.

Ruiyang explained that the “source‑code scanning” solution helps enterprises tackle increasingly complex on‑premise, cloud and AI security challenges. It supports pure on‑premise and hybrid deployments, ensures sensitive data never leaves the country, and offers core advantages such as precise false‑positive filtering (Reachability), AI‑and‑software‑supply‑chain asset inventory (SBOM/AI‑BOM), and AI‑assisted real‑time remediation (Shift‑Left). The solution also features clear billing logic and transparent metrics for budget control.

Ruiyang emphasized that combining Mend.io’s advanced protection with Ruiyang’s 40‑year‑long local technical expertise enables companies to comprehensively strengthen digital resilience while balancing compliance, cost and efficiency.

Regarding its ESG carbon‑footprint assessment business, Ruiyang noted rising performance and significant results. In addition to a long‑standing base of listed and OTC company renewal customers, the firm recently added multinational logistics leader Kerry Logistics, which adopted Ruiyang’s Vital NetZero zero‑carbon cloud system to accelerate carbon‑footprint surveys across hundreds of its locations.

Ruiyang also launched Vital ESG sustainability indicator management, helping listed companies easily organize implementation processes and outcomes, facilitate collaboration with consulting firms, and efficiently integrate and manage sustainability disclosures across the corporate and supply‑chain value chain. This links to sustainability report preparation and opens a new era of digital ESG governance and business opportunities.

items.title: 國際大行狂拉警報！法國興業銀行：美債10年期殖利率升破5.5% 股市將受重創
items.title_en: Major Global Banks Sound the Alarm! Societe Generale: 10-Year U.S. Treasury Yield Over 5.5% Will Slam Stock Markets
paras: 愈來愈多國際大行就美債殖利率攀漲對股市的衝擊發出警告，法國興業銀行最新加入這一行列，該行全球資產配置主管Alain Bokobza表示，10年期美債殖利率升至5.5%，恐為借貸成本壓倒獲利增長、進而壓縮估值的臨界點。
Bokobza出具最新研報指出，今年全球企業獲利預期大幅上調，因此即便殖利率走高，股票風險溢價並未坍塌，「股票現在並不比年初更貴」，但一旦10年期美債殖利率觸及5.5%，獲利上調將不足以支撐現有估值，即「股票開始受到衝擊」的水平。
他還預期，聯準會(Fed)與歐洲央行(ECB)後續升息幅度溫和，不足以打斷經濟周期，他將大趨勢形容為名義GDP的「長期上升」，動力包括德日財政支出高企、通膨頑固，以及AI基建帶來的資本需求激增。
近期債市重新主導股市情緒。美伊衝突推高油價，叠加央行鷹派信號、財政憂慮及AI資本開支爭奪資金，10年期美債收益率目前接近4.78%，上周一度觸及4.82%，創2023年以來新高。
摩根大通與巴克萊均視5%為關鍵心理關口。摩根大通全球投資策略主管Grace Peters警告，觸及5%恐觸發「膝反應」，美股面臨5%至8%回調壓力；巴克萊歐亞股票策略主管Emmanuel Cau亦表憂慮。
洛克菲勒國際董事長Ruchir Sharma更指出，美債規模已破40兆美元，若殖利率「決定性突破5%」的網路泡沫時代以來的區間上沿，AI泡沫可能破裂。
paras_en: More and more major international banks are warning that rising U.S. Treasury yields could hit equity markets, and France's Societe Generale has now joined the chorus. The bank’s global asset‑allocation head Alain Bokobza said a 10‑year Treasury yield that climbs to 5.5% could become the tipping point where borrowing costs outweigh profit growth and compress valuations.

Bokobza’s latest research note says this year’s global corporate‑profit outlook has been sharply upgraded, so even with higher yields the equity risk premium has not collapsed – “stocks are not more expensive now than at the start of the year.” However, once the 10‑year yield hits 5.5%, the profit upgrades will be insufficient to sustain current multiples, and “stocks will start to feel the pain.”

He also expects the Fed and the ECB to keep any further rate hikes modest, not enough to break the economic cycle. He describes the overarching trend as a “long‑term rise” in nominal GDP, driven by high fiscal spending in Germany and Japan, stubborn inflation, and a surge in capital demand from AI‑related infrastructure spending.

Bond markets have recently taken the lead in shaping market sentiment. The Israel‑Iran conflict has pushed oil prices higher, and combined with hawkish central‑bank signals, fiscal worries and AI capital‑spending battles for cash, the 10‑year Treasury yield is now near 4.78% and touched 4.82% last week, a peak not seen since 2023.

JPMorgan and Barclays both see 5% as a key psychological threshold. JPMorgan’s global investment strategy head Grace Peters warned that hitting 5% could trigger a “knee‑jerk reaction,” exposing U.S. equities to a 5%‑to‑8% pull‑back, and Barclays Asia‑Europe equities head Emmanuel Cau echoed the concern.

Rockefeller International chairman Ruchir Sharma added that U.S. debt now exceeds $40 trillion, and if yields decisively break above the 5% upper bound that has defined the internet‑bubble era, the AI bubble could also burst.

items.title: 安謀催生實體AI生態系 慧友躋身合作夥伴搶攻2000億美元運算商機
items.title_en: Arm Fuels Physical AI Ecosystem; Taiwan's Huiyou Joins Partners to Chase $200 Billion Computing Opportunity
paras: 矽智財大廠安謀(ARM-US)於9月8日正式發表Arm實體AI全面設計生態系計畫，宣布將Arm Total Design拓展至實體AI與機器人領域，串聯全球80多家橫跨技術堆疊的合作夥伴。台灣安控廠慧友(5484-TW)也名列生態系夥伴名單中，在發表會現場主舞台夥伴牆上正式亮相，並被歸類在致動與感測關鍵層級，展現其從傳統工控轉型至高階AI視覺辨識的實力。
安謀評估實體AI所涵蓋的全球經濟活動規模達數兆美元，至2030年左右可望形成每年2000億美元的運算商機，去年相關出貨量更已突破20億套。安謀此次串聯的生態系夥伴涵蓋AWS、Hugging Face、恩智浦與西門子等國際巨頭，而作為台廠的慧友，在打入輝達的機器人生態系後，藉由深耕多年的視覺感測解決方案，同樣成為安謀的實體AI生態系夥伴。
在實體落地應用方面，慧友以感知、理解、決策與行動為架構，將核心視覺監控與邊緣運算技術拓展至自主機器人領域。除了中階自主決策機械手臂已於歐美展開物流與食品分級篩選應用外，搭載高階運算模組的旗艦機種更順利打入歐美供應鏈，投入最後一哩路配送的機器狗終端設備。
慧友目前透過長期深耕的車載專案作為堅實基底，穩定的車隊更新需求為公司挹注穩健現金流。在車用基礎支持下，慧友全面推進AI視覺、機器人運算控制器與半導體設備相關訂單，本季專案出貨動能持續增溫，全年營運目標力拚全面轉虧為盈。
paras_en: Arm, the leading silicon IP company, announced on September 8 its Arm Physical AI end‑to‑end design ecosystem, extending Arm Total Design into physical AI and robotics and linking more than 80 partners across the technology stack. Taiwan’s industrial‑control maker Huiyou (5484‑TW) is listed among the ecosystem partners, appearing on the main‑stage partner wall at the launch and classified in the actuation and sensing tier, showcasing its transition from traditional industrial control to advanced AI visual recognition.

Arm estimates the global economic activity covered by physical AI to be in the trillions of dollars, with an annual $200 billion computing market expected around 2030 and shipments already exceeding 2 billion units last year. The ecosystem includes international giants such as AWS, Hugging Face, NXP and Siemens, and Huiyou, after entering Nvidia’s robot ecosystem, leverages its long‑standing visual‑sensing solutions to become an Arm physical‑AI partner as well.

In concrete applications, Huiyou builds on perception, understanding, decision‑making and action to extend its core visual monitoring and edge‑computing technologies into autonomous robots. Mid‑range autonomous decision‑making robotic arms are already deployed in logistics and food‑sorting in Europe and the U.S., while a flagship model equipped with a high‑end compute module has entered the European‑American supply chain, powering robot‑dog devices for last‑mile delivery.

Huiyou’s solid foundation comes from long‑term automotive projects that provide steady cash flow through regular fleet upgrades. With this automotive base, the company is pushing AI vision, robot compute controllers and semiconductor‑equipment orders, with project shipments gaining momentum this quarter and a full‑year goal of turning a profit after a loss.

items.title: 國泰證9月投資觀點 看聯準會有更多維持按兵不動的空間
items.title_en: Cathay Securities' September Investment Outlook: More Room for the Fed to Hold Steady
paras: 國泰證券今(8)日發布9月投資觀點指出，儘管油價、發債供給與財政赤字議題推升美債利率，但近期美國通膨回落、就業數據放緩，讓美國聯準會有更多維持按兵不動的空間。
市場目前對9月聯準會升息的預測是機率超過50%，並緊密關注即將公布的CPI，國泰證分析，整體而言近期市場波動較大，但外資並未明顯撤離，投行也普遍看好後市，實質需求並未退場，隨著通膨回落、就業數據放緩，讓美國聯準會有更多維持按兵不動的空間，利率可能維持區間震盪。
延續8月企業獲利和AI落地應用的市場焦點，國泰證進一步將目光轉向AI基礎建設的承載能力，隨著AI投資占美國GDP比重續升，看好美國、中港日和黃金、債券等投資機會，並關注電力、營建和融資等三大資源的發展。
國泰證指出，依目前已發布的資本支出預估推算，AI投資占美國GDP比重持續增加，顯示本輪成長動能仍有延伸空間，而台韓半導體設備進口、PMI、記憶體採購和GPU租賃價格等領先指標，也處於2022年以來高位。
國泰證認為，尚無明顯證據顯示AI投資已對美國經濟造成嚴重的資源排擠，但隨著資料中心持續擴建，未來1-2年營建勞工、電力設備和資本市場的供需壓力可能逐步升高。
因此，電力、營建和融資等三大資源能否跟上AI資本支出步調，將是下一階段AI成長動能能否延續的重要觀察指標。
此外，國泰證提到，美國企業營收和獲利持續成長，基本面仍具支撐，但消費動能可能已接近短期高點，加上美伊暫時停火協議到期後局勢尚未明朗，市場追價態度轉趨審慎。
paras_en: Cathay Securities released its September investment outlook today (the 8th), noting that although oil prices, bond issuance supply, and fiscal deficits have pushed U.S. Treasury yields higher, recent declines in U.S. inflation and a slowdown in employment data give the Federal Reserve more room to keep rates unchanged.

The market currently predicts a probability of over 50% for a Fed rate hike in September and is closely watching the upcoming CPI release. Cathay Securities analysis says overall market volatility has been high lately, but foreign investors have not noticeably withdrawn, and investment banks generally remain bullish on the outlook. Real demand has not disappeared; with inflation easing and employment slowing, the Fed has more leeway to hold rates steady, likely keeping rates in a range‑bound oscillation.

Continuing the August focus on corporate earnings and AI implementation, Cathay Securities turns its attention to the capacity of AI infrastructure. As AI investment’s share of U.S. GDP keeps rising, the firm sees opportunities in the United States, Greater China, Japan, as well as in gold and bonds, while monitoring the development of three key resources: electricity, construction, and financing.

Cathay Securities points out that, based on current capital‑expenditure forecasts, AI investment’s share of U.S. GDP is continuously increasing, indicating that this growth cycle still has room to extend. Leading indicators such as Taiwan and South Korea’s semiconductor‑equipment imports, PMI, memory‑chip purchases, and GPU‑rental prices are also at their highest levels since 2022.

Cathay Securities believes there is no clear evidence that AI investment has yet caused serious resource crowding out in the U.S. economy, but as data centers keep expanding, the supply‑demand pressure on construction labor, power equipment, and capital markets may gradually rise over the next one to two years.

Therefore, whether the three major resources—electricity, construction, and financing—can keep pace with AI capital spending will be a key gauge of whether AI’s growth momentum can be sustained in the next phase.

In addition, Cathay Securities notes that U.S. corporate revenues and earnings continue to grow, providing solid fundamentals, but consumer momentum may have peaked in the short term. Moreover, after the temporary U.S.–Iran cease‑fire agreement expires, the geopolitical situation remains uncertain, prompting the market to adopt a more cautious stance toward price chasing.

items.title: 系統電IPC、無人機第二成長曲線成形 Q4營收估逐步成長
items.title_en: System Power IPC and Drone Second Growth Curve Shaping Q4 Revenue Expected to Gradually Grow
paras: 工業電腦廠系統電(5309-TW)8月營收3.28億元，月增2.68%、年增27.55%，連續二個月改寫單月歷史新高；累計前8月營收24.17億元，年增9.37%。受惠AI伺服器BBU(備援電池模組)需求緩升、加上工業電腦、無人機系統成為第二成長曲線，可望帶動第四季營收表現逐步成長。
系統電表示，隨著採購政策預算落地、非紅供應鏈需求升溫、無人機產品持續出貨，以及地面控制站(GCS)進入放量準備階段，並藉由美國在地製造優勢，擴大切入北美無人機供應鏈商機。
系統電進一步指出，美國德州Plano廠深度的設計製造布局，可彈性生產無人機、IPC、BBU、TPMS產品、及SMT，能縮短北美客戶交期，加上台灣南投廠南崗廠，在地緣政治及全球無人機需求加速狀態下，提供完整非紅供應鏈、在地製造及後勤服務，成為爭取歐美訂單的重要關鍵條件。
此外，依美台互惠貿易協議，台灣原產貨品輸美原則上適用最惠國稅率或15%稅率兩者較高者；系統電透過Plano廠落實美國在地製造，可降低15%基準關稅帶來的影響，同時降低跨境物流及供應鏈政策風險，成為爭取美國政府與大型企業採購案的重要利基。
paras_en: Industrial computer maker System Power (5309‑TW) reported August revenue of NT$328 million, up 2.68% month‑over‑month and 27.55% year‑over‑year, marking the second consecutive month of a new single‑month record. Cumulative revenue for the first eight months reached NT$2.417 billion, a 9.37% increase from a year earlier. Benefiting from a modest rise in demand for AI server BBU (backup battery modules) and the emergence of industrial computers and drone systems as a second growth curve, the company expects Q4 revenue to grow steadily.

System Power said that with procurement policy budgets taking effect, non‑Red supply‑chain demand heating up, continued shipments of drone products, and ground control stations (GCS) entering a volume‑ramp phase, it will leverage its U.S. local manufacturing advantage to expand into the North American drone supply‑chain opportunity.

The company further noted that its deep design‑manufacturing footprint at the Plano, Texas plant enables flexible production of drones, IPCs, BBUs, TPMS products and SMT, shortening delivery times for North American customers. Combined with its Nantou‑Nan‑Gang facility in Taiwan, the firm can offer a complete non‑Red supply chain, local manufacturing and logistics services amid accelerating geopolitical tensions and global drone demand, which is a key factor in winning European and American orders.

In addition, under the U.S.–Taiwan reciprocal trade agreement, Taiwanese‑origin goods exported to the United States are generally subject to the higher of the most‑favoured‑nation rate or a 15% tariff. By manufacturing in the United States through its Plano plant, System Power can mitigate the impact of the 15% baseline tariff, reduce cross‑border logistics costs and supply‑chain policy risks, creating a strategic advantage in securing U.S. government and large‑enterprise procurement contracts.

items.title: 中聯油品事件再掀波  泰山今提告中聯、福壽、福懋及南僑求償10億元
items.title_en: Taishan Files 1 Billion NTD Claim Against Zhonglian, Fushou, Fumao and Nankiao Over Oil Incident
paras: 泰山(1218-TW)今(8)日正式委任友理法律事務所，由行銷副總鈕安澤代表陪同至台北地方法院遞狀，對中聯油脂、福壽實業(1219-TW)、福懋(1225-TW)及南僑(1702-TW)四家公司提起民事訴訟，針對中聯油脂事件造成的相關損失，求償10億元。

泰山表示，事件發生初期因司法調查仍在進行，公司無從完整掌握供應鏈各方的知情與處理過程，直到檢方偵查終結、藉由起訴書揭露的資訊，回頭檢視南僑公開聲明、相關事證後，發現各公司取得異常資訊的時間、掌握程度及後續處理存在明顯落差。泰山強調，公司不迴避自身應負的責任，但也不能讓其他環節應負的責任，最終全部由泰山及股東承擔。經審慎評估，擬針對 這四家公司提起民事訴訟，針對產品回收、庫存銷毀、消費者賠償、營業及商譽損失等，求償10億元。
泰山指出，提告理由包括 ，南僑5月已多次驗出異常，泰山卻持有SGS商品合格報告；若資訊即時揭露，風險控管可提前啟動
依南僑自行公開聲明，其於5月13日就福壽公司油罐車留存採樣油品進行檢測，驗出苯駢芘4.6μg/kg超標；5月22日複測仍呈超標，之後再委託第三方SGS檢驗，並於6月4日取得8.0μg/kg的超標結果。南僑同時表示，其油槽原料油及生產成品檢測均為合格。
但與南僑同樣於4月8、9日接收中聯大豆沙拉油的泰山，4月10日即將自家成品送交SGS檢驗，4月21日取得的則是合格報告。在未取得其他異常資訊的情況下，泰山自然判斷自身產品符合標準。
泰山主張，倘若南僑於5月中首次驗出異常後，便及時揭露相關資訊並啟動通報，使中聯及相關股東公司應可同步展開溯源、交叉複驗及風險控管，泰山即有機會在仍持有SGS合格報告的情況下，重新檢視自身產品與來源。
從5月中至6月中，正是本事件能否提前止血的關鍵時間。異常資訊未能及時傳遞，是否因此延後整體供應鏈的追溯與風險控管，進一步擴大泰山後續回收、銷毀、消費者賠償及商譽損害，將請法院依法釐清。
同時，泰山認為，供應鏈陸續出現多重異常訊號，各公司掌握資訊與處置責任應分別釐清；依起訴書所呈現之時間序，南僑相關異常資訊後續進入福壽及中聯體系；但５月中亦出現台糖原料脫膠油檢驗異常拒收，福懋向中聯提出苯駢芘超標的檢驗要求等情事。顯見在泰山品保人員在6月15日參與中聯品保聯席會議以前，供應鏈不同環節已陸續出現風險訊號。
泰山認為，中聯身為生產與管理端，以及福壽、福懋等相關公司，究竟於何時取得何種異常資訊、採取何種處理、是否及時傳遞風險，以及各自應負何種損害責任，均應透過司法程序分別認定。
泰山尊重檢方對6月15日後通報義務所提出之法律主張，相關責任將於刑事司法程序中依法說明。但泰山也認為，若供應鏈前端已存在的異常資訊得以更早完整傳遞，啟動溯源與風險控管措施，極有機會減少後續回收、銷毀及品牌損害。
泰山指出，以起訴書中呈現福壽福懋等公司，於6月29日晚間，相關人員均已得知「泰山即將履行通報主管機關義務」；至6月30日上午，中聯董事長蔡清松仍曾聯繫泰山董事長劉偉龍進行溝通，但未能改變泰山於６月29日履行通報義務之決定，更顯示各家公司在資訊掌握、風險處置及面對通報之立場並非完全一致。共同身為中聯股東，不代表各公司在事件中的法律責任與損害責任即可混為一談。
泰山表示，一個半月前與福壽、福懋共同站上證交所道歉，是因為泰山身為中聯股東及董事，面對已經造成的食品安全疑慮與社會不安，沒有理由等待責任釐清後，才面對消費者。當時泰山仍期待三大股東能共同面對問題，透過第三方全面檢視、重整制度；甚至以大破大立的方式重新建立中聯的食品安全與公司治理。

今日決定提告，泰山指出，則是因為隨著相關事件陸續揭露，發現各家公司取得異常資訊的時間與後續處理及通報問題上態度上未能採取相同立場。泰山認為，真正的合作伙伴，不只是共同持有一家公司的股份，更應在重大風險發生時共同揭露資訊、共同面對問題、共同承擔責任。原本期待透過股東共同改革中聯、重新建立治理制度的想法，恐怕已失去最基本的信賴前提。該負的責任，泰山不會迴避；但當共同改革已失去信賴的前提，該追究的責任，泰山也不再沉默。
paras_en: Taishan (1218‑TW) formally appointed Friend & Legal Law Firm today (the 8th), with marketing vice‑president Niu Anze accompanying to file a petition at the Taipei District Court, suing Zhonglian Oil, Fushou Industrial (1219‑TW), Fumao (1225‑TW) and Nankiao (1702‑TW) for civil damages of NT$1 billion arising from the Zhonglian oil incident.

Taishan said that in the early stage of the incident, because the judicial investigation was still ongoing, the company could not fully grasp the knowledge and handling processes of each party in the supply chain. Only after the prosecution’s investigation concluded and information disclosed in the indictment was reviewed—especially Nankiao’s public statements and related evidence—did Taishan discover clear gaps in the timing, degree of awareness and subsequent handling of abnormal information by the companies. Taishan stresses that it does not evade its own responsibility, but it should not bear the entire burden for responsibilities that belong to other links. After careful assessment, it intends to sue the four companies for product recall, inventory destruction, consumer compensation, operating and goodwill losses, seeking NT$1 billion in damages.

Taishan pointed out that the grounds for filing include that Nankiao had repeatedly detected abnormalities in May, while Taishan still held an SGS‑certified product report; had the information been disclosed promptly, risk control could have been activated earlier.

According to Nankiao’s own public statement, on May 13 it tested oil sampled from Fushou’s tanker and found benzo[a]pyrene at 4.6 µg/kg, exceeding the limit; a re‑test on May 22 still showed excess, and a third‑party SGS test on June 4 reported 8.0 µg/kg, also over the limit. Nankiao also said that its oil tank raw material and finished product tests were compliant.

However, Taishan, which received Zhonglian’s soybean salad oil on April 8‑9, sent its own product for SGS testing on April 10 and obtained a compliance report on April 21. Without any other abnormal information, Taishan naturally concluded its product met standards.

Taishan argues that if Nankiao had promptly disclosed the abnormality detected in mid‑May and triggered a notification, Zhonglian and related shareholder companies could have simultaneously started trace‑back, cross‑verification and risk‑control measures, giving Taishan a chance to reassess its product and source even while still holding the SGS compliance report.

The period from mid‑May to mid‑June is the critical window for stopping the damage early. The failure to transmit abnormal information in time may have delayed supply‑chain traceability and risk control, further expanding Taishan’s subsequent recall, destruction, consumer compensation and goodwill loss, which the court should clarify according to law.

Taishan also notes that multiple abnormal signals have emerged along the supply chain, and each company’s information handling and responsibility should be distinguished. Based on the timeline in the indictment, Nankiao’s abnormal information later entered the Fushou and Zhonglian systems; but in mid‑May there were also incidents such as Taiwan Sugar’s raw‑material de‑gel oil being rejected for abnormal test results and Fumao requesting Zhonglian to test for benzo[a]pyrene excess. It shows that before Taishan’s quality‑assurance staff participated in Zhonglian’s joint QA meeting on June 15, risk signals had already appeared at various supply‑chain stages.

Taishan believes that Zhonglian, as the producer and manager, together with Fushou, Fumao and other related firms, must have their own timelines for obtaining abnormal information, the actions taken, whether risks were communicated promptly, and the respective damage liabilities, all of which should be determined separately through judicial proceedings.

Taishan respects the prosecutor’s legal claim regarding the reporting obligation after June 15, and the related liability will be explained in criminal proceedings. However, Taishan also maintains that if the abnormal information existing at the upstream of the supply chain had been fully transmitted earlier, initiating trace‑back and risk‑control measures could have greatly reduced later recalls, destructions and brand damage.

Taishan points out that, according to the indictment, on the evening of June 29, personnel from Fushou, Fumao and other companies learned that “Taishan would fulfill its duty to report to the regulator”; on the morning of June 30, Zhonglian chairman Cai Qingsong still contacted Taishan chairman Liu Weilong, but could not change Taishan’s decision to report on June 29, further showing that the companies’ information handling, risk response and stance on reporting were not fully aligned. Being co‑shareholders of Zhonglian does not mean their legal and damage responsibilities can be conflated.

Taishan said that a month and a half earlier, together with Fushou and Fumao, it stood on the Taiwan Stock Exchange to apologize because, as a Zhonglian shareholder and director, Taishan could not wait for liability clarification before facing consumers amid food‑safety concerns and social unrest. At that time Taishan still hoped the three major shareholders could jointly address the issue through comprehensive third‑party review and system overhaul, even rebuilding Zhonglian’s food safety and corporate governance on a “break‑to‑rebuild” basis.

Today’s decision to sue, Taishan explained, stems from the ongoing revelations that each company’s timing of obtaining abnormal information, subsequent handling and reporting attitudes were not consistent. Taishan believes a true partner not only co‑holds shares but also discloses information, faces problems and shares responsibility together when major risks arise. The original hope of joint shareholder reform of Zhonglian and rebuilding its governance has likely lost its basic trust premise. Taishan will not evade the responsibilities it owes, but now that trust is gone, it will no longer remain silent on the liabilities that must be pursued.

items.title: AI軟實力串聯硬體！00770擬配6元創掛牌新高 年化殖利率近9%
items.title_en: AI Software Strength Links Hardware! 00770 Plans NT$6 Dividend, New Record High, Annual Yield Near 9%
paras: 採年配機制的國泰北美科技(00770-TW)本月將迎來除息，每單位預計配發 6 元，刷新掛牌以來新高，以昨(7)日收盤價 68.45 元估算，年化殖利率高達 8.77%。隨著 2026 年除息時間調整，結合年初已發的 4.2 元，投資人今年可包攬兩次股息，最後買進日為 9 月 15 日。加上輝達、博通與蘋果等成分股相繼爆發，讓 00770 成為卡位美股 AI 成長的市場焦點。
00770 過去固定於每年年初進行除息，自 2026 年起正式將配息時程調整至 9 月。00770 在 2026 年初已配發 4.2 元，加上本次預計發放的 6 元，投資人於 2026 全年度合計可領取高達 10.2 元的現金股利。想要領息的投資人，要注意 9 月 15 日為最後買進日，9 月 16 日展開除息，收益分配發放日則落在 10 月 15 日。

國泰北美科技 ETF 基金經理人林淑娟表示，近期科技產業聚焦於不只競爭誰的晶片快，更開始拚誰能把硬體、軟體與服務串得更完整。輝達日前斥資35億美元認購聯發科海外可轉換公司債，雙方深化AI基礎建設、在地AI運算及車用等領域合作，聯發科也將採用NVLink Fusion，為客戶開發客製化AI加速器，顯示科技大廠正透過策略合作擴大技術版圖。00770除布局輝達，也納入微軟、Alphabet等大型平台業者，可同時參與硬體運算、雲端及平台服務的發展機會。

另一方面，客製化晶片與記憶體正成為AI硬體市場的新焦點，00770主要持股博通最新一季營收達296億美元、年增86%，其中AI半導體營收167億美元、年增221%；美光HBM4也已進入量產。林淑娟指出，隨AI運算量增加，除了晶片算得快，資料傳輸速度及記憶體能否跟上同樣關鍵，高速網路、客製化晶片與高頻寬記憶體的重要性隨之提升，00770同時布局輝達、博通及美光等業者，也讓投資範圍不侷限於單一技術或產品。
近日科技產業還有另一個觀察重點，00770主要持股蘋果(AAPL-US)將於台北時間9月10日凌晨舉行秋季發表會，市場除期待新品規格，新技術能否創造更多使用情境及換機需求也受到矚目。林淑娟認為，過去市場重視企業投入多少資源發展AI，接下來更值得觀察的是消費者是否願意為新功能買單；若新技術能真正融入日常使用，科技產業的成長動能也有機會進一步由企業端向消費市場延伸。
展望後市，林淑娟表示，科技產業長期創新方向未變，但題材逐漸由單一算力競賽向更多領域擴散，企業表現也可能更加分化。00770產業占比截至9月3日科技類83.26%、通訊類12.97%，未來可持續觀察科技大廠新品周期、企業獲利及新技術落地進度，掌握北美科技產業發展契機。

paras_en: Cathay North America Technology (00770‑TW), which uses an annual dividend mechanism, will declare a dividend this month, distributing NT$6 per unit – a new high since listing. Based on the closing price of NT$68.45 on the 7th, the annualized yield reaches 8.77%. With the 2026 dividend timing change and the NT$4.2 already paid earlier this year, investors can capture two payouts in 2026, with the last purchase date on September 15. The rally in Nvidia, Broadcom and Apple stocks has made 00770 a market focus for positioning in U.S. AI growth.

Historically, 00770 paid dividends at the beginning of each year, but starting in 2026 the payout schedule shifts to September. After the NT$4.2 paid at the start of 2026, the planned NT$6 adds up to a total cash dividend of NT$10.2 for the full year. Investors seeking the dividend must note that September 15 is the final purchase date, the ex‑dividend date is September 16, and the distribution date is October 15.

Fund manager Lin Shujian of the Cathay North America Technology ETF said the tech sector is now focusing not only on whose chips are faster, but also on who can integrate hardware, software and services most comprehensively. Nvidia recently spent US$3.5 billion to subscribe to MediaTek’s overseas convertible bonds, deepening cooperation in AI infrastructure, edge AI computing and automotive applications. MediaTek will also adopt NVLink Fusion to develop custom AI accelerators for customers, showing that tech giants are expanding their technology footprints through strategic partnerships. In addition to Nvidia, 00770 holds stakes in Microsoft, Alphabet and other large platform players, giving exposure to hardware computing, cloud and platform services.

On another front, custom chips and memory are becoming new focal points in the AI hardware market. 00770’s top holding Broadcom reported Q3 revenue of US$29.6 billion, up 86% year‑over‑year, with AI semiconductor revenue of US$16.7 billion, up 221%; Micron’s HBM4 has also entered mass production. Lin noted that as AI compute demand rises, fast chip performance alone isn’t enough – data‑transfer speed and memory bandwidth are equally critical. The importance of high‑speed networking, custom chips and high‑bandwidth memory is therefore growing. By holding Nvidia, Broadcom and Micron, 00770’s exposure is not limited to a single technology or product.

Another current tech‑industry watch‑point is that 00770’s major holding Apple (AAPL‑US) will hold its autumn product launch in the early hours of September 10 Taipei time. Besides speculating on new product specs, the market is also watching whether new technologies can create more usage scenarios and drive upgrade demand. Lin believes that while the market has traditionally focused on how much companies invest in AI development, the next key question is whether consumers are willing to pay for new features. If new tech truly integrates into daily life, the growth momentum of the tech sector could extend further from the enterprise side to the consumer market.

Looking ahead, Lin says the long‑term innovation direction of the tech sector remains unchanged, but themes are shifting from a single compute‑power race to broader areas, leading to more differentiated corporate performance. As of September 3, 00770’s sector allocation was 83.26% technology and 12.97% communications. Future observation points include new‑product cycles of major tech firms, corporate earnings and the rollout pace of new technologies, to capture opportunities in North American tech development.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉川湖8月營收年增逾3倍 但獲利了結賣壓湧現跌近8%
items.title_en: Focus Stock: Chuanhu’s August Revenue More Than Triples YoY but Profit‑Taking Pressure Triggers Near‑8% Drop
paras: 伺服器導軌廠川湖(2059-TW)公布8月營收為64.7億元，續創歷史新高且年增逾3倍，今(8)日面臨獲利了結賣壓，開盤股價衝上14200元後卻遭遇沉重獲利了結賣壓翻黑急殺，盤中最低下探12670元，跌幅一度逼近9%，跌破5日、20日均線，成交量較前一日放大。
川湖8月營收64.7億元，延續歷史新高紀錄，月增0.9%，年增率則達344.4%，累計前8月營收291.5億元，年增率落在164%。受惠AI伺服器新產品開始出貨放量，公司營運成長動能持續走揚。
即便股價短線劇烈修正，美系外資在最新報告中指出，川湖8月營收表現符合預期，本季至今累計營收已達外資預估第3季營收的66%，CSP業者伺服器需求持續暢旺，看好川湖未來發展。
paras_en: Server rail manufacturer Chuanhu (2059‑TW) reported August revenue of NT$6.47 billion, setting a new historical high and more than tripling year‑over‑year. On the day (the 8th), the stock faced profit‑taking pressure: after opening up to NT$14,200, it quickly fell under heavy selling pressure, sinking to a intraday low of NT$12,670, a drop that at one point neared 9%, breaking below the 5‑day and 20‑day moving averages, with trading volume expanding versus the previous day.

Chuanhu’s August revenue of NT$6.47 billion continued its record‑high streak, up 0.9% month‑over‑month and up 344.4% year‑over‑year. Cumulative revenue for the first eight months reached NT$29.15 billion, a 164% year‑over‑year increase. Benefiting from the ramp‑up of AI server new product shipments, the company’s operational growth momentum remains strong.

Even though the stock price underwent a sharp short‑term correction, U.S. investors noted in their latest report that Chuanhu’s August revenue met expectations. To date this quarter, cumulative revenue already accounts for 66% of foreign investors’ estimate for Q3 revenue. Server demand from CSP providers stays robust, and they remain optimistic about Chuanhu’s future development.

items.title: 叡揚攜手Mend.io 拓AI資安版圖
items.title_en: Ruiyang Partners with Mend.io to Expand AI Cybersecurity Portfolio
paras: 軟體服務商叡揚(6752-TW)公布8月合併營收1.75億元，月減1.61%，年增11.4%，前8月合併營收13.41億元，年增5.66%，叡揚看準AI發展帶動的資安需求，也宣布引進國際資安品牌Mend.io 「源碼掃描」解決方案，增添營運新動能。
叡揚表示，「源碼掃描」解決方案，是為協助企業因應日益複雜的地雲架構和AI 資安挑戰，可支援純地端與混合部署，確保機敏資料不出境，更具備「精準過濾假警報(Reachability) 」、「AI 與軟體供應鏈資產盤點(SBOM / AI-BOM)」以及「AI 輔助即時修復(Shift-Left) 」等核心優勢，也能搭配清楚的計費邏輯與透明的統計數字來管控預算。
叡揚強調，透過 Mend.io 的先進防護結合叡揚 40 年深厚的在地技術團隊，可協助企業在兼顧合規、成本與效率下，全面強化數位韌性。
而在 ESG 碳盤查業務方面，叡揚說明，業績看漲、成效顯著，除了有累積多年的上市(櫃)公司續約客戶，近期再增添上市跨國物流服務業嘉里大榮採用旗下Vital NetZero 零碳雲系統，以加速旗下上百處營業據點碳盤查作業。
而叡揚接續推出 Vital ESG 永續指標管理，協助上市櫃公司內部方便擺放執行過程和結果，也方便跟顧問公司協同互動提升效率，有效整合並管理公司及供應鏈上下游的永續資訊揭露，銜接永續報告書編製，開啟永續e化治理新時代與新商機。
paras_en: Software service provider Ruiyang (6752-TW) reported August consolidated revenue of NT$175 million, down 1.61% month‑over‑month but up 11.4% year‑over‑year. For the first eight months, consolidated revenue reached NT$1.341 billion, a 5.66% annual increase. Spotting growing cybersecurity demand driven by AI, Ruiyang also announced the adoption of the international security brand Mend.io’s “source‑code scanning” solution to add new operational momentum.

Ruiyang explained that the “source‑code scanning” solution helps enterprises tackle increasingly complex on‑premise, cloud and AI security challenges. It supports pure on‑premise and hybrid deployments, ensures sensitive data never leaves the country, and offers core advantages such as precise false‑positive filtering (Reachability), AI‑and‑software‑supply‑chain asset inventory (SBOM/AI‑BOM), and AI‑assisted real‑time remediation (Shift‑Left). The solution also features clear billing logic and transparent metrics for budget control.

Ruiyang emphasized that combining Mend.io’s advanced protection with Ruiyang’s 40‑year‑long local technical expertise enables companies to comprehensively strengthen digital resilience while balancing compliance, cost and efficiency.

Regarding its ESG carbon‑footprint assessment business, Ruiyang noted rising performance and significant results. In addition to a long‑standing base of listed and OTC company renewal customers, the firm recently added multinational logistics leader Kerry Logistics, which adopted Ruiyang’s Vital NetZero zero‑carbon cloud system to accelerate carbon‑footprint surveys across hundreds of its locations.

Ruiyang also launched Vital ESG sustainability indicator management, helping listed companies easily organize implementation processes and outcomes, facilitate collaboration with consulting firms, and efficiently integrate and manage sustainability disclosures across the corporate and supply‑chain value chain. This links to sustainability report preparation and opens a new era of digital ESG governance and business opportunities.

items.title: 安謀催生實體AI生態系 慧友躋身合作夥伴搶攻2000億美元運算商機
items.title_en: Arm Fuels Physical AI Ecosystem; Taiwan's Huiyou Joins Partners to Chase $200 Billion Computing Opportunity
paras: 矽智財大廠安謀(ARM-US)於9月8日正式發表Arm實體AI全面設計生態系計畫，宣布將Arm Total Design拓展至實體AI與機器人領域，串聯全球80多家橫跨技術堆疊的合作夥伴。台灣安控廠慧友(5484-TW)也名列生態系夥伴名單中，在發表會現場主舞台夥伴牆上正式亮相，並被歸類在致動與感測關鍵層級，展現其從傳統工控轉型至高階AI視覺辨識的實力。
安謀評估實體AI所涵蓋的全球經濟活動規模達數兆美元，至2030年左右可望形成每年2000億美元的運算商機，去年相關出貨量更已突破20億套。安謀此次串聯的生態系夥伴涵蓋AWS、Hugging Face、恩智浦與西門子等國際巨頭，而作為台廠的慧友，在打入輝達的機器人生態系後，藉由深耕多年的視覺感測解決方案，同樣成為安謀的實體AI生態系夥伴。
在實體落地應用方面，慧友以感知、理解、決策與行動為架構，將核心視覺監控與邊緣運算技術拓展至自主機器人領域。除了中階自主決策機械手臂已於歐美展開物流與食品分級篩選應用外，搭載高階運算模組的旗艦機種更順利打入歐美供應鏈，投入最後一哩路配送的機器狗終端設備。
慧友目前透過長期深耕的車載專案作為堅實基底，穩定的車隊更新需求為公司挹注穩健現金流。在車用基礎支持下，慧友全面推進AI視覺、機器人運算控制器與半導體設備相關訂單，本季專案出貨動能持續增溫，全年營運目標力拚全面轉虧為盈。
paras_en: Arm, the leading silicon IP company, announced on September 8 its Arm Physical AI end‑to‑end design ecosystem, extending Arm Total Design into physical AI and robotics and linking more than 80 partners across the technology stack. Taiwan’s industrial‑control maker Huiyou (5484‑TW) is listed among the ecosystem partners, appearing on the main‑stage partner wall at the launch and classified in the actuation and sensing tier, showcasing its transition from traditional industrial control to advanced AI visual recognition.

Arm estimates the global economic activity covered by physical AI to be in the trillions of dollars, with an annual $200 billion computing market expected around 2030 and shipments already exceeding 2 billion units last year. The ecosystem includes international giants such as AWS, Hugging Face, NXP and Siemens, and Huiyou, after entering Nvidia’s robot ecosystem, leverages its long‑standing visual‑sensing solutions to become an Arm physical‑AI partner as well.

In concrete applications, Huiyou builds on perception, understanding, decision‑making and action to extend its core visual monitoring and edge‑computing technologies into autonomous robots. Mid‑range autonomous decision‑making robotic arms are already deployed in logistics and food‑sorting in Europe and the U.S., while a flagship model equipped with a high‑end compute module has entered the European‑American supply chain, powering robot‑dog devices for last‑mile delivery.

Huiyou’s solid foundation comes from long‑term automotive projects that provide steady cash flow through regular fleet upgrades. With this automotive base, the company is pushing AI vision, robot compute controllers and semiconductor‑equipment orders, with project shipments gaining momentum this quarter and a full‑year goal of turning a profit after a loss.

items.title: 國泰證9月投資觀點 看聯準會有更多維持按兵不動的空間
items.title_en: Cathay Securities' September Investment Outlook: More Room for the Fed to Hold Steady
paras: 國泰證券今(8)日發布9月投資觀點指出，儘管油價、發債供給與財政赤字議題推升美債利率，但近期美國通膨回落、就業數據放緩，讓美國聯準會有更多維持按兵不動的空間。
市場目前對9月聯準會升息的預測是機率超過50%，並緊密關注即將公布的CPI，國泰證分析，整體而言近期市場波動較大，但外資並未明顯撤離，投行也普遍看好後市，實質需求並未退場，隨著通膨回落、就業數據放緩，讓美國聯準會有更多維持按兵不動的空間，利率可能維持區間震盪。
延續8月企業獲利和AI落地應用的市場焦點，國泰證進一步將目光轉向AI基礎建設的承載能力，隨著AI投資占美國GDP比重續升，看好美國、中港日和黃金、債券等投資機會，並關注電力、營建和融資等三大資源的發展。
國泰證指出，依目前已發布的資本支出預估推算，AI投資占美國GDP比重持續增加，顯示本輪成長動能仍有延伸空間，而台韓半導體設備進口、PMI、記憶體採購和GPU租賃價格等領先指標，也處於2022年以來高位。
國泰證認為，尚無明顯證據顯示AI投資已對美國經濟造成嚴重的資源排擠，但隨著資料中心持續擴建，未來1-2年營建勞工、電力設備和資本市場的供需壓力可能逐步升高。
因此，電力、營建和融資等三大資源能否跟上AI資本支出步調，將是下一階段AI成長動能能否延續的重要觀察指標。
此外，國泰證提到，美國企業營收和獲利持續成長，基本面仍具支撐，但消費動能可能已接近短期高點，加上美伊暫時停火協議到期後局勢尚未明朗，市場追價態度轉趨審慎。
paras_en: Cathay Securities released its September investment outlook today (the 8th), noting that although oil prices, bond issuance supply, and fiscal deficits have pushed U.S. Treasury yields higher, recent declines in U.S. inflation and a slowdown in employment data give the Federal Reserve more room to keep rates unchanged.

The market currently predicts a probability of over 50% for a Fed rate hike in September and is closely watching the upcoming CPI release. Cathay Securities analysis says overall market volatility has been high lately, but foreign investors have not noticeably withdrawn, and investment banks generally remain bullish on the outlook. Real demand has not disappeared; with inflation easing and employment slowing, the Fed has more leeway to hold rates steady, likely keeping rates in a range‑bound oscillation.

Continuing the August focus on corporate earnings and AI implementation, Cathay Securities turns its attention to the capacity of AI infrastructure. As AI investment’s share of U.S. GDP keeps rising, the firm sees opportunities in the United States, Greater China, Japan, as well as in gold and bonds, while monitoring the development of three key resources: electricity, construction, and financing.

Cathay Securities points out that, based on current capital‑expenditure forecasts, AI investment’s share of U.S. GDP is continuously increasing, indicating that this growth cycle still has room to extend. Leading indicators such as Taiwan and South Korea’s semiconductor‑equipment imports, PMI, memory‑chip purchases, and GPU‑rental prices are also at their highest levels since 2022.

Cathay Securities believes there is no clear evidence that AI investment has yet caused serious resource crowding out in the U.S. economy, but as data centers keep expanding, the supply‑demand pressure on construction labor, power equipment, and capital markets may gradually rise over the next one to two years.

Therefore, whether the three major resources—electricity, construction, and financing—can keep pace with AI capital spending will be a key gauge of whether AI’s growth momentum can be sustained in the next phase.

In addition, Cathay Securities notes that U.S. corporate revenues and earnings continue to grow, providing solid fundamentals, but consumer momentum may have peaked in the short term. Moreover, after the temporary U.S.–Iran cease‑fire agreement expires, the geopolitical situation remains uncertain, prompting the market to adopt a more cautious stance toward price chasing.

items.title: 系統電IPC、無人機第二成長曲線成形 Q4營收估逐步成長
items.title_en: System Power IPC and Drone Second Growth Curve Shaping Q4 Revenue Expected to Gradually Grow
paras: 工業電腦廠系統電(5309-TW)8月營收3.28億元，月增2.68%、年增27.55%，連續二個月改寫單月歷史新高；累計前8月營收24.17億元，年增9.37%。受惠AI伺服器BBU(備援電池模組)需求緩升、加上工業電腦、無人機系統成為第二成長曲線，可望帶動第四季營收表現逐步成長。
系統電表示，隨著採購政策預算落地、非紅供應鏈需求升溫、無人機產品持續出貨，以及地面控制站(GCS)進入放量準備階段，並藉由美國在地製造優勢，擴大切入北美無人機供應鏈商機。
系統電進一步指出，美國德州Plano廠深度的設計製造布局，可彈性生產無人機、IPC、BBU、TPMS產品、及SMT，能縮短北美客戶交期，加上台灣南投廠南崗廠，在地緣政治及全球無人機需求加速狀態下，提供完整非紅供應鏈、在地製造及後勤服務，成為爭取歐美訂單的重要關鍵條件。
此外，依美台互惠貿易協議，台灣原產貨品輸美原則上適用最惠國稅率或15%稅率兩者較高者；系統電透過Plano廠落實美國在地製造，可降低15%基準關稅帶來的影響，同時降低跨境物流及供應鏈政策風險，成為爭取美國政府與大型企業採購案的重要利基。
paras_en: Industrial computer maker System Power (5309‑TW) reported August revenue of NT$328 million, up 2.68% month‑over‑month and 27.55% year‑over‑year, marking the second consecutive month of a new single‑month record. Cumulative revenue for the first eight months reached NT$2.417 billion, a 9.37% increase from a year earlier. Benefiting from a modest rise in demand for AI server BBU (backup battery modules) and the emergence of industrial computers and drone systems as a second growth curve, the company expects Q4 revenue to grow steadily.

System Power said that with procurement policy budgets taking effect, non‑Red supply‑chain demand heating up, continued shipments of drone products, and ground control stations (GCS) entering a volume‑ramp phase, it will leverage its U.S. local manufacturing advantage to expand into the North American drone supply‑chain opportunity.

The company further noted that its deep design‑manufacturing footprint at the Plano, Texas plant enables flexible production of drones, IPCs, BBUs, TPMS products and SMT, shortening delivery times for North American customers. Combined with its Nantou‑Nan‑Gang facility in Taiwan, the firm can offer a complete non‑Red supply chain, local manufacturing and logistics services amid accelerating geopolitical tensions and global drone demand, which is a key factor in winning European and American orders.

In addition, under the U.S.–Taiwan reciprocal trade agreement, Taiwanese‑origin goods exported to the United States are generally subject to the higher of the most‑favoured‑nation rate or a 15% tariff. By manufacturing in the United States through its Plano plant, System Power can mitigate the impact of the 15% baseline tariff, reduce cross‑border logistics costs and supply‑chain policy risks, creating a strategic advantage in securing U.S. government and large‑enterprise procurement contracts.

items.title: 中聯油品事件再掀波  泰山今提告中聯、福壽、福懋及南僑求償10億元
items.title_en: Taishan Files 1 Billion NTD Claim Against Zhonglian, Fushou, Fumao and Nankiao Over Oil Incident
paras: 泰山(1218-TW)今(8)日正式委任友理法律事務所，由行銷副總鈕安澤代表陪同至台北地方法院遞狀，對中聯油脂、福壽實業(1219-TW)、福懋(1225-TW)及南僑(1702-TW)四家公司提起民事訴訟，針對中聯油脂事件造成的相關損失，求償10億元。

泰山表示，事件發生初期因司法調查仍在進行，公司無從完整掌握供應鏈各方的知情與處理過程，直到檢方偵查終結、藉由起訴書揭露的資訊，回頭檢視南僑公開聲明、相關事證後，發現各公司取得異常資訊的時間、掌握程度及後續處理存在明顯落差。泰山強調，公司不迴避自身應負的責任，但也不能讓其他環節應負的責任，最終全部由泰山及股東承擔。經審慎評估，擬針對 這四家公司提起民事訴訟，針對產品回收、庫存銷毀、消費者賠償、營業及商譽損失等，求償10億元。
泰山指出，提告理由包括 ，南僑5月已多次驗出異常，泰山卻持有SGS商品合格報告；若資訊即時揭露，風險控管可提前啟動
依南僑自行公開聲明，其於5月13日就福壽公司油罐車留存採樣油品進行檢測，驗出苯駢芘4.6μg/kg超標；5月22日複測仍呈超標，之後再委託第三方SGS檢驗，並於6月4日取得8.0μg/kg的超標結果。南僑同時表示，其油槽原料油及生產成品檢測均為合格。
但與南僑同樣於4月8、9日接收中聯大豆沙拉油的泰山，4月10日即將自家成品送交SGS檢驗，4月21日取得的則是合格報告。在未取得其他異常資訊的情況下，泰山自然判斷自身產品符合標準。
泰山主張，倘若南僑於5月中首次驗出異常後，便及時揭露相關資訊並啟動通報，使中聯及相關股東公司應可同步展開溯源、交叉複驗及風險控管，泰山即有機會在仍持有SGS合格報告的情況下，重新檢視自身產品與來源。
從5月中至6月中，正是本事件能否提前止血的關鍵時間。異常資訊未能及時傳遞，是否因此延後整體供應鏈的追溯與風險控管，進一步擴大泰山後續回收、銷毀、消費者賠償及商譽損害，將請法院依法釐清。
同時，泰山認為，供應鏈陸續出現多重異常訊號，各公司掌握資訊與處置責任應分別釐清；依起訴書所呈現之時間序，南僑相關異常資訊後續進入福壽及中聯體系；但５月中亦出現台糖原料脫膠油檢驗異常拒收，福懋向中聯提出苯駢芘超標的檢驗要求等情事。顯見在泰山品保人員在6月15日參與中聯品保聯席會議以前，供應鏈不同環節已陸續出現風險訊號。
泰山認為，中聯身為生產與管理端，以及福壽、福懋等相關公司，究竟於何時取得何種異常資訊、採取何種處理、是否及時傳遞風險，以及各自應負何種損害責任，均應透過司法程序分別認定。
泰山尊重檢方對6月15日後通報義務所提出之法律主張，相關責任將於刑事司法程序中依法說明。但泰山也認為，若供應鏈前端已存在的異常資訊得以更早完整傳遞，啟動溯源與風險控管措施，極有機會減少後續回收、銷毀及品牌損害。
泰山指出，以起訴書中呈現福壽福懋等公司，於6月29日晚間，相關人員均已得知「泰山即將履行通報主管機關義務」；至6月30日上午，中聯董事長蔡清松仍曾聯繫泰山董事長劉偉龍進行溝通，但未能改變泰山於６月29日履行通報義務之決定，更顯示各家公司在資訊掌握、風險處置及面對通報之立場並非完全一致。共同身為中聯股東，不代表各公司在事件中的法律責任與損害責任即可混為一談。
泰山表示，一個半月前與福壽、福懋共同站上證交所道歉，是因為泰山身為中聯股東及董事，面對已經造成的食品安全疑慮與社會不安，沒有理由等待責任釐清後，才面對消費者。當時泰山仍期待三大股東能共同面對問題，透過第三方全面檢視、重整制度；甚至以大破大立的方式重新建立中聯的食品安全與公司治理。

今日決定提告，泰山指出，則是因為隨著相關事件陸續揭露，發現各家公司取得異常資訊的時間與後續處理及通報問題上態度上未能採取相同立場。泰山認為，真正的合作伙伴，不只是共同持有一家公司的股份，更應在重大風險發生時共同揭露資訊、共同面對問題、共同承擔責任。原本期待透過股東共同改革中聯、重新建立治理制度的想法，恐怕已失去最基本的信賴前提。該負的責任，泰山不會迴避；但當共同改革已失去信賴的前提，該追究的責任，泰山也不再沉默。
paras_en: Taishan (1218‑TW) formally appointed Friend & Legal Law Firm today (the 8th), with marketing vice‑president Niu Anze accompanying to file a petition at the Taipei District Court, suing Zhonglian Oil, Fushou Industrial (1219‑TW), Fumao (1225‑TW) and Nankiao (1702‑TW) for civil damages of NT$1 billion arising from the Zhonglian oil incident.

Taishan said that in the early stage of the incident, because the judicial investigation was still ongoing, the company could not fully grasp the knowledge and handling processes of each party in the supply chain. Only after the prosecution’s investigation concluded and information disclosed in the indictment was reviewed—especially Nankiao’s public statements and related evidence—did Taishan discover clear gaps in the timing, degree of awareness and subsequent handling of abnormal information by the companies. Taishan stresses that it does not evade its own responsibility, but it should not bear the entire burden for responsibilities that belong to other links. After careful assessment, it intends to sue the four companies for product recall, inventory destruction, consumer compensation, operating and goodwill losses, seeking NT$1 billion in damages.

Taishan pointed out that the grounds for filing include that Nankiao had repeatedly detected abnormalities in May, while Taishan still held an SGS‑certified product report; had the information been disclosed promptly, risk control could have been activated earlier.

According to Nankiao’s own public statement, on May 13 it tested oil sampled from Fushou’s tanker and found benzo[a]pyrene at 4.6 µg/kg, exceeding the limit; a re‑test on May 22 still showed excess, and a third‑party SGS test on June 4 reported 8.0 µg/kg, also over the limit. Nankiao also said that its oil tank raw material and finished product tests were compliant.

However, Taishan, which received Zhonglian’s soybean salad oil on April 8‑9, sent its own product for SGS testing on April 10 and obtained a compliance report on April 21. Without any other abnormal information, Taishan naturally concluded its product met standards.

Taishan argues that if Nankiao had promptly disclosed the abnormality detected in mid‑May and triggered a notification, Zhonglian and related shareholder companies could have simultaneously started trace‑back, cross‑verification and risk‑control measures, giving Taishan a chance to reassess its product and source even while still holding the SGS compliance report.

The period from mid‑May to mid‑June is the critical window for stopping the damage early. The failure to transmit abnormal information in time may have delayed supply‑chain traceability and risk control, further expanding Taishan’s subsequent recall, destruction, consumer compensation and goodwill loss, which the court should clarify according to law.

Taishan also notes that multiple abnormal signals have emerged along the supply chain, and each company’s information handling and responsibility should be distinguished. Based on the timeline in the indictment, Nankiao’s abnormal information later entered the Fushou and Zhonglian systems; but in mid‑May there were also incidents such as Taiwan Sugar’s raw‑material de‑gel oil being rejected for abnormal test results and Fumao requesting Zhonglian to test for benzo[a]pyrene excess. It shows that before Taishan’s quality‑assurance staff participated in Zhonglian’s joint QA meeting on June 15, risk signals had already appeared at various supply‑chain stages.

Taishan believes that Zhonglian, as the producer and manager, together with Fushou, Fumao and other related firms, must have their own timelines for obtaining abnormal information, the actions taken, whether risks were communicated promptly, and the respective damage liabilities, all of which should be determined separately through judicial proceedings.

Taishan respects the prosecutor’s legal claim regarding the reporting obligation after June 15, and the related liability will be explained in criminal proceedings. However, Taishan also maintains that if the abnormal information existing at the upstream of the supply chain had been fully transmitted earlier, initiating trace‑back and risk‑control measures could have greatly reduced later recalls, destructions and brand damage.

Taishan points out that, according to the indictment, on the evening of June 29, personnel from Fushou, Fumao and other companies learned that “Taishan would fulfill its duty to report to the regulator”; on the morning of June 30, Zhonglian chairman Cai Qingsong still contacted Taishan chairman Liu Weilong, but could not change Taishan’s decision to report on June 29, further showing that the companies’ information handling, risk response and stance on reporting were not fully aligned. Being co‑shareholders of Zhonglian does not mean their legal and damage responsibilities can be conflated.

Taishan said that a month and a half earlier, together with Fushou and Fumao, it stood on the Taiwan Stock Exchange to apologize because, as a Zhonglian shareholder and director, Taishan could not wait for liability clarification before facing consumers amid food‑safety concerns and social unrest. At that time Taishan still hoped the three major shareholders could jointly address the issue through comprehensive third‑party review and system overhaul, even rebuilding Zhonglian’s food safety and corporate governance on a “break‑to‑rebuild” basis.

Today’s decision to sue, Taishan explained, stems from the ongoing revelations that each company’s timing of obtaining abnormal information, subsequent handling and reporting attitudes were not consistent. Taishan believes a true partner not only co‑holds shares but also discloses information, faces problems and shares responsibility together when major risks arise. The original hope of joint shareholder reform of Zhonglian and rebuilding its governance has likely lost its basic trust premise. Taishan will not evade the responsibilities it owes, but now that trust is gone, it will no longer remain silent on the liabilities that must be pursued.

items.title: AI軟實力串聯硬體！00770擬配6元創掛牌新高 年化殖利率近9%
items.title_en: AI Software Strength Links Hardware! 00770 Plans NT$6 Dividend, New Record High, Annual Yield Near 9%
paras: 採年配機制的國泰北美科技(00770-TW)本月將迎來除息，每單位預計配發 6 元，刷新掛牌以來新高，以昨(7)日收盤價 68.45 元估算，年化殖利率高達 8.77%。隨著 2026 年除息時間調整，結合年初已發的 4.2 元，投資人今年可包攬兩次股息，最後買進日為 9 月 15 日。加上輝達、博通與蘋果等成分股相繼爆發，讓 00770 成為卡位美股 AI 成長的市場焦點。
00770 過去固定於每年年初進行除息，自 2026 年起正式將配息時程調整至 9 月。00770 在 2026 年初已配發 4.2 元，加上本次預計發放的 6 元，投資人於 2026 全年度合計可領取高達 10.2 元的現金股利。想要領息的投資人，要注意 9 月 15 日為最後買進日，9 月 16 日展開除息，收益分配發放日則落在 10 月 15 日。

國泰北美科技 ETF 基金經理人林淑娟表示，近期科技產業聚焦於不只競爭誰的晶片快，更開始拚誰能把硬體、軟體與服務串得更完整。輝達日前斥資35億美元認購聯發科海外可轉換公司債，雙方深化AI基礎建設、在地AI運算及車用等領域合作，聯發科也將採用NVLink Fusion，為客戶開發客製化AI加速器，顯示科技大廠正透過策略合作擴大技術版圖。00770除布局輝達，也納入微軟、Alphabet等大型平台業者，可同時參與硬體運算、雲端及平台服務的發展機會。

另一方面，客製化晶片與記憶體正成為AI硬體市場的新焦點，00770主要持股博通最新一季營收達296億美元、年增86%，其中AI半導體營收167億美元、年增221%；美光HBM4也已進入量產。林淑娟指出，隨AI運算量增加，除了晶片算得快，資料傳輸速度及記憶體能否跟上同樣關鍵，高速網路、客製化晶片與高頻寬記憶體的重要性隨之提升，00770同時布局輝達、博通及美光等業者，也讓投資範圍不侷限於單一技術或產品。
近日科技產業還有另一個觀察重點，00770主要持股蘋果(AAPL-US)將於台北時間9月10日凌晨舉行秋季發表會，市場除期待新品規格，新技術能否創造更多使用情境及換機需求也受到矚目。林淑娟認為，過去市場重視企業投入多少資源發展AI，接下來更值得觀察的是消費者是否願意為新功能買單；若新技術能真正融入日常使用，科技產業的成長動能也有機會進一步由企業端向消費市場延伸。
展望後市，林淑娟表示，科技產業長期創新方向未變，但題材逐漸由單一算力競賽向更多領域擴散，企業表現也可能更加分化。00770產業占比截至9月3日科技類83.26%、通訊類12.97%，未來可持續觀察科技大廠新品周期、企業獲利及新技術落地進度，掌握北美科技產業發展契機。

paras_en: Cathay North America Technology (00770‑TW), which uses an annual dividend mechanism, will declare a dividend this month, distributing NT$6 per unit – a new high since listing. Based on the closing price of NT$68.45 on the 7th, the annualized yield reaches 8.77%. With the 2026 dividend timing change and the NT$4.2 already paid earlier this year, investors can capture two payouts in 2026, with the last purchase date on September 15. The rally in Nvidia, Broadcom and Apple stocks has made 00770 a market focus for positioning in U.S. AI growth.

Historically, 00770 paid dividends at the beginning of each year, but starting in 2026 the payout schedule shifts to September. After the NT$4.2 paid at the start of 2026, the planned NT$6 adds up to a total cash dividend of NT$10.2 for the full year. Investors seeking the dividend must note that September 15 is the final purchase date, the ex‑dividend date is September 16, and the distribution date is October 15.

Fund manager Lin Shujian of the Cathay North America Technology ETF said the tech sector is now focusing not only on whose chips are faster, but also on who can integrate hardware, software and services most comprehensively. Nvidia recently spent US$3.5 billion to subscribe to MediaTek’s overseas convertible bonds, deepening cooperation in AI infrastructure, edge AI computing and automotive applications. MediaTek will also adopt NVLink Fusion to develop custom AI accelerators for customers, showing that tech giants are expanding their technology footprints through strategic partnerships. In addition to Nvidia, 00770 holds stakes in Microsoft, Alphabet and other large platform players, giving exposure to hardware computing, cloud and platform services.

On another front, custom chips and memory are becoming new focal points in the AI hardware market. 00770’s top holding Broadcom reported Q3 revenue of US$29.6 billion, up 86% year‑over‑year, with AI semiconductor revenue of US$16.7 billion, up 221%; Micron’s HBM4 has also entered mass production. Lin noted that as AI compute demand rises, fast chip performance alone isn’t enough – data‑transfer speed and memory bandwidth are equally critical. The importance of high‑speed networking, custom chips and high‑bandwidth memory is therefore growing. By holding Nvidia, Broadcom and Micron, 00770’s exposure is not limited to a single technology or product.

Another current tech‑industry watch‑point is that 00770’s major holding Apple (AAPL‑US) will hold its autumn product launch in the early hours of September 10 Taipei time. Besides speculating on new product specs, the market is also watching whether new technologies can create more usage scenarios and drive upgrade demand. Lin believes that while the market has traditionally focused on how much companies invest in AI development, the next key question is whether consumers are willing to pay for new features. If new tech truly integrates into daily life, the growth momentum of the tech sector could extend further from the enterprise side to the consumer market.

Looking ahead, Lin says the long‑term innovation direction of the tech sector remains unchanged, but themes are shifting from a single compute‑power race to broader areas, leading to more differentiated corporate performance. As of September 3, 00770’s sector allocation was 83.26% technology and 12.97% communications. Future observation points include new‑product cycles of major tech firms, corporate earnings and the rollout pace of new technologies, to capture opportunities in North American tech development.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉川湖8月營收年增逾3倍 但獲利了結賣壓湧現跌近8%
items.title_en: Focus Stock: Chuanhu’s August Revenue More Than Triples YoY but Profit‑Taking Pressure Triggers Near‑8% Drop
paras: 伺服器導軌廠川湖(2059-TW)公布8月營收為64.7億元，續創歷史新高且年增逾3倍，今(8)日面臨獲利了結賣壓，開盤股價衝上14200元後卻遭遇沉重獲利了結賣壓翻黑急殺，盤中最低下探12670元，跌幅一度逼近9%，跌破5日、20日均線，成交量較前一日放大。
川湖8月營收64.7億元，延續歷史新高紀錄，月增0.9%，年增率則達344.4%，累計前8月營收291.5億元，年增率落在164%。受惠AI伺服器新產品開始出貨放量，公司營運成長動能持續走揚。
即便股價短線劇烈修正，美系外資在最新報告中指出，川湖8月營收表現符合預期，本季至今累計營收已達外資預估第3季營收的66%，CSP業者伺服器需求持續暢旺，看好川湖未來發展。
paras_en: Server rail manufacturer Chuanhu (2059‑TW) reported August revenue of NT$6.47 billion, setting a new historical high and more than tripling year‑over‑year. On the day (the 8th), the stock faced profit‑taking pressure: after opening up to NT$14,200, it quickly fell under heavy selling pressure, sinking to a intraday low of NT$12,670, a drop that at one point neared 9%, breaking below the 5‑day and 20‑day moving averages, with trading volume expanding versus the previous day.

Chuanhu’s August revenue of NT$6.47 billion continued its record‑high streak, up 0.9% month‑over‑month and up 344.4% year‑over‑year. Cumulative revenue for the first eight months reached NT$29.15 billion, a 164% year‑over‑year increase. Benefiting from the ramp‑up of AI server new product shipments, the company’s operational growth momentum remains strong.

Even though the stock price underwent a sharp short‑term correction, U.S. investors noted in their latest report that Chuanhu’s August revenue met expectations. To date this quarter, cumulative revenue already accounts for 66% of foreign investors’ estimate for Q3 revenue. Server demand from CSP providers stays robust, and they remain optimistic about Chuanhu’s future development.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉含「積」量高半導體ETF走強 00892靠鴻勁、穎崴飆漲衝近2月新高
items.title_en: Focus Stock: High‑Accumulation Semiconductor ETFs Rally; 00892 Leverages Hong Jin and Ying Wai Surge Near Two‑Month High
paras: 台股今(8)日走勢震盪，半導體族群呈現兩樣情，雖然聯發科、聯電回檔，但權王台積電強勢撐盤，一度大漲1.8%逼近歷史新高，帶動市值型與半導體ETF表現亮眼。其中，富邦台灣半導體(00892-TW)靠著台積電與穎崴、鴻勁、旺矽等AI概念股加持，創下近 2 個月新高。法人指出，在AI與先進封裝需求強勁下，台灣半導體供應鏈將持續掌握全球AI建設商機。

受惠於台積電的強勢表現，含「積」量較高的大型市值型ETF如元大台灣50(0050-TW)、富邦科技(0052-TW)皆穩守平盤之上。半導體主題型 ETF 不乏亮點，其中富邦台灣半導體(00892-TW)盤中一度勁揚1.8%，市價最高達43.2元，創下近2個月新高；中信關鍵半導體(00891-TW)亦上漲超過1%，最高觸及36.29元；台新臺灣半導體30(00904-TW)盤中也有近1%的漲幅表現。
進一步觀察00892今日漲幅勝過其他同類型ETF的主因，除了權重高達24%的台積電貢獻主要動能外，成分股中的中小型強勢股更是重要推手，目前權重升至約 7% 的股王信驊與鴻勁分列第三、四大持股，今日雙雙走高，鴻勁盤中更是飆漲逾 8%；此外，權重約 5% 的第八大持股旺矽同樣猛攻大漲約8%、第九大持股穎崴更攻上漲停板，多點開花的成分股表現成功拉升 00892 的整體績效。
富邦台灣半導體 ETF 經理人陳双吉表示，台股9月在AI題材、SEMICON Taiwan展覽效應及低檔承接買盤挹注下，科技股重拾動能。隨全球雲端服務供應商(CSP)持續擴大AI資本支出，自研ASIC與高效能運算需求同步升溫，帶動先進製程、先進封裝及高階測試需求持續擴張，半導體供應鏈仍是台股中長線重要成長主軸。
法人指出，尤其AI晶片複雜度與運算效能持續提升，高階測試介面的需求同步增加，相關概念股如穎崴(6515-TW)受惠AI應用訂單暢旺、AI、HPC帶動高階測試及MEMS探針卡需求、8月營收大幅增長，近期表現亮眼，顯示市場資金持續聚焦AI高階測試供應鏈。
陳双吉指出，隨AI晶片朝高算力、高頻寬及客製化方向發展，晶片測試難度與測試時間同步提高，加上CPO、先進封裝等新技術加速導入，高階探針卡、測試座及測試介面需求可望延續成長，也使半導體產業的投資機會由前段製程進一步向後段測試擴散。
展望後市，台美企業獲利預估持續上修，加上AI資本支出維持高檔，有利半導體產業中長期成長短線仍須留意美國PPI、CPI及Fed政策預期變化，建議透過半導體ETF分批布局，掌握AI算力升級、先進製程、先進封裝及高階測試等半導體供應鏈成長契機。

paras_en: Taiwan stocks were volatile today (the 8th), with the semiconductor sector showing mixed performance. While MediaTek and UMC retreated, market leader TSMC strongly supported the market, surging 1.8% toward a historic high and boosting the performance of market‑cap and semiconductor ETFs. Notably, Fubon Taiwan Semiconductor ETF (00892‑TW) hit a near‑two‑month high, buoyed by AI‑related holdings such as TSMC, Ying Wai, Hong Jin and Wang Si. Institutional investors note that strong AI and advanced‑packaging demand will keep Taiwan’s semiconductor supply chain at the forefront of global AI construction opportunities.

Benefiting from TSMC’s strong showing, large‑cap ETFs with higher accumulation like Yuanta Taiwan 50 (0050‑TW) and Fubon Technology (0052‑TW) stayed above flat lines. Semiconductor‑themed ETFs also shone: Fubon Taiwan Semiconductor (00892‑TW) jumped as much as 1.8% intraday, reaching a peak price of NT$43.2, a two‑month high; CTBC Key Semiconductor (00891‑TW) rose over 1% to a high of NT$36.29; and Taishin Taiwan Semiconductor 30 (00904‑TW) posted nearly a 1% gain during trading.

The main reason 00892 outperformed its peers today was not only the 24% weight of TSMC providing core momentum, but also strong performance from mid‑ and small‑cap constituents. The top holdings now include Xin Hua (≈7% weight) and Hong Jin, ranking third and fourth, both climbing higher, with Hong Jin soaring more than 8% intraday. Additionally, the eighth‑largest holding Wang Si (≈5% weight) surged about 8%, and ninth‑largest Ying Wai hit the daily limit up, creating a multi‑point lift that lifted the overall performance of 00892.

Fubon Taiwan Semiconductor ETF manager Chen Shuang‑ji said that in September Taiwan stocks regain momentum in technology shares thanks to AI themes, the SEMICON Taiwan exhibition effect and low‑price buying support. As global cloud service providers continue to expand AI capital expenditures, demand for in‑house ASICs and high‑performance computing rises, driving growth in advanced processes, advanced packaging and high‑end testing, keeping the semiconductor supply chain a key long‑term growth engine for Taiwan’s market.

Institutions point out that as AI chip complexity and computing power keep rising, demand for high‑end test interfaces also grows. Related concept stocks such as Ying Wai (6515‑TW) benefit from robust AI order flow, AI‑driven HPC boosting high‑end testing and MEMS probe‑card demand, and a sharp revenue jump in August, showing that market capital continues to focus on the AI high‑end testing supply chain.

Chen Shuang‑ji added that as AI chips move toward higher compute power, bandwidth and customization, chip‑testing difficulty and time increase. Coupled with accelerated adoption of CPO and advanced packaging, demand for high‑end probe cards, test sockets and test interfaces is expected to keep growing, expanding investment opportunities from front‑end processes to back‑end testing in the semiconductor industry.

Looking ahead, profit forecasts for Taiwan‑U.S. companies are being continuously revised upward, and sustained high AI capital spending supports the semiconductor industry’s medium‑term growth. Short‑term attention should remain on U.S. PPI, CPI and Fed policy expectations. Investors are advised to build positions in semiconductor ETFs gradually to capture growth opportunities in AI compute upgrades, advanced processes, advanced packaging and high‑end testing within the semiconductor supply chain.
