items.title: 蘋果優質客戶服務神話破滅？M4 MacBook Pro修6次仍故障、曾承諾換機卻沒下文
items.title_en: Apple's Premium Customer Service Myth Shattered? M4 MacBook Pro Repaired Six Times Still Faulty, Promised Replacement Never Materialized
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US) 一向以客服服務受到消費者肯定，但近日一名M4 MacBook Pro用戶卻遇上截然不同的經歷。這名用戶表示，自己的14吋M4 MacBook Pro歷經多次維修仍無法正常運作，蘋果客服甚至曾以書面確認將為他更換整台電腦，後續卻遲遲沒有履行承諾。
根據《Wccftech》報導，Reddit網友Abdallah透露，他持有的14吋M4 MacBook Pro雖然僅是前一代機型，卻已接受多次硬體維修，包括兩度更換主機板、換過顯示器，以及上蓋角度感測器。
由於電腦在使用時仍出現異常，例如執行遊戲時速度緩慢，Abdallah向蘋果客服尋求協助。蘋果客服一名資深顧問後來透過官方電子郵件通知他，表示將更換一台新的M4 MacBook Pro。
根據蘋果當時提供的說明，由於相同規格的機型預計要到9月才會補貨，因此新機將在9月寄出。然而，當更換時間到來後，Abdallah多次透過電子郵件聯繫，卻未獲得實質回覆。
在沒有其他辦法的情況下，他甚至寄信給前蘋果執行長庫克（Tim Cook），試圖進一步升級處理這起客訴。
事件曝光後，也在Reddit引發討論。有網友認為，蘋果既然已向客戶提供書面協議，明確承諾更換產品，就應履行對客戶作出的承諾。
不過，另一名網友「TheRyznhawk」指出，蘋果通常不會直接更換MacBook，能夠符合換機條件的產品主要是iPhone、iPad及其他配件。
他表示，MacBook可以透過不同零組件重新組裝，因此只有在少數特殊情況下才會直接提供整機更換。
TheRyznhawk也提到，即使這款M4 MacBook Pro已經歷6次維修，他仍不認為這代表該產品應獲得特殊待遇。
不過，這也引發另一項疑問：如果只是一般硬體故障，為何蘋果客服經過6次維修後，仍無法讓這台MacBook正常運作？或許代表電腦可能存在尚未被找出的其他硬體問題。
雖然部分網友的回應可能讓Abdallah感到失望，但也有人鼓勵他持續向蘋果反映，直到問題獲得解決。
原文也提及，過去確實曾出現蘋果提供升級換機的案例。例如，一名用戶原本使用M2 Max MacBook Pro，最後獲得M5 Max MacBook Pro作為替換機，並額外取得部分商店抵用額度；另一名使用2019年英特爾(INTC-US) 處理器MacBook的消費者，則曾在無需額外付費的情況下獲得M5 MacBook Pro。
整體而言，蘋果過去曾出現讓消費者感受到優質客服服務的案例，但此次M4 MacBook Pro用戶在多次維修後仍無法解決問題，加上蘋果先前曾書面承諾換機卻未進一步落實，使事件受到關注。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) has long been praised for its customer service, but recently an M4 MacBook Pro user experienced a completely different story. The user says his 14‑inch M4 MacBook Pro underwent multiple repairs yet still could not operate properly, and Apple customer support even confirmed in writing that they would replace the entire computer, but the promise was never fulfilled.

According to a report by Wccftech, Reddit user Abdallah disclosed that his 14‑inch M4 MacBook Pro, although only a previous‑generation model, has already undergone several hardware repairs, including two motherboard replacements, a screen swap, and a replacement of the lid‑angle sensor.

Because the computer continued to exhibit issues during use—such as sluggish performance when gaming—Abdallah sought help from Apple support. A senior Apple advisor later notified him via official email that a new M4 MacBook Pro would be sent as a replacement.

Apple’s explanation at the time stated that the same‑spec model would not be restocked until September, so the new unit would be shipped in September. However, when the replacement time arrived, Abdallah sent multiple follow‑up emails but received no substantive response.
With no other recourse, he even wrote to former Apple CEO Tim Cook in an attempt to further elevate the complaint.

The incident’s exposure sparked discussion on Reddit. Some commenters argued that since Apple had provided a written agreement explicitly promising a replacement, the company should honor its commitment to the customer.
However, another Reddit user, “TheRyznhawk,” pointed out that Apple typically does not replace MacBooks directly; replacement eligibility usually applies to iPhones, iPads, and other accessories.
He explained that MacBooks can be reassembled from individual components, so a full‑unit replacement is only offered in rare, special cases.
TheRyznhawk also noted that even though this M4 MacBook Pro had undergone six repairs, he does not believe that alone warrants special treatment for the product.

Nevertheless, this raises another question: if it is merely a standard hardware failure, why was Apple unable to get the MacBook functioning properly after six repairs? It may indicate that the computer has other, as‑yet‑undetected hardware issues.
While some users’ responses may have disappointed Abdallah, others encouraged him to keep reporting the issue to Apple until it is resolved.

The original article also mentioned past instances where Apple did provide upgrade replacements. For example, a user originally using an M2 Max MacBook Pro eventually received an M5 Max MacBook Pro as a replacement, along with some store credit; another consumer with a 2019 Intel (INTC-US)‑based MacBook obtained an M5 MacBook Pro without any additional cost.

Overall, Apple has historically had cases that made consumers feel they received premium customer service, but this M4 MacBook Pro user’s problem remains unresolved after multiple repairs, and Apple’s prior written promise to replace the unit was never acted upon, drawing attention to the issue.

items.title: 蘋果採用中國記憶體要成真？長鑫科技發表聲明釋訊號
items.title_en: Apple's Use of Chinese Memory Chips Could Become Reality? ChangXin Technology Issues Statement
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US) 與中國記憶體大廠長鑫科技(688825-CN) 的合作談判近期再度釋出正面訊號，長鑫科技最新表態願與全球頂級客戶探索合作機會，使外界因此認為，雙方合作案可能逐步走向明朗。不過，若蘋果與中國記憶體業者建立合作關係，也可能使其在美國面臨更大的政治敏感度。
根據《Wccftech》報導，蘋果近期正尋求增加記憶體供應端的議價空間，除了美光科技(MU-US) 、三星電子(005930KS) 、SK海力士(000660KS) 及鎧俠（Kioxia）等主要記憶體供應商外，長鑫科技也成為潛在合作對象。
另一方面，美國政府據報也可能將蘋果與長鑫科技的潛在合作，視為與中國進行談判時可運用的籌碼。美國總統川普與中國國家主席習近平預計於本月底訪美期間接觸，在此背景下，相關合作案也受到關注。
長鑫科技近期針對與蘋果的談判釋出最新訊號，表示：「我們對於與全球頂尖客戶探索合作機會持開放態度。目前，我們的產品在效能、品質及供應可靠度方面，已具備與全球領先供應商競爭的能力。」
長鑫科技目前正積極擴充產能，預計今年底前透過3座300mm晶圓廠，將月產能提升至約30萬片，平均每座晶圓廠月產能約10萬片。
此外，公司也正擴充以高頻寬記憶體（HBM）為重點的產能，預計到2026年底達到每月約5萬片。
長鑫科技同時在上海及合肥興建兩座新晶圓廠，完成後將進一步推升整體月產能至60萬片。按照目前擴產進度，長鑫科技預計最快在2030年超越美光的量產規模。
除了擴大產能，長鑫科技的記憶體技術也持續提升。目前公司已進入LPDDR5X量產階段，並開始生產LPDDR6，另外也計畫在今年稍晚啟動HBM3量產。
在製程微縮面臨限制的情況下，長鑫科技據報也開始採用高介電常數金屬閘極（High-k Metal Gate，HKMG）技術，以氧化鉿（HfO₂）等材料取代傳統矽基絕緣層。這項技術可降低漏電流及相關熱能損耗，同時提升能源使用效率，並為更高運算速度提供條件。
儘管長鑫科技持續擴大產能並提升技術能力，但蘋果若最終與其合作，預計也不會完全依賴長鑫科技供應中國市場所需的記憶體。
目前估計，蘋果與中國市場相關的記憶體需求約達6億GB，計算基礎為每年約5000萬支裝置、平均每支使用12GB記憶體。
考慮到長鑫科技目前產能已排滿至2027年，且產能利用率約達95%，蘋果可能僅會透過長鑫科技滿足部分中國市場的記憶體需求。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) and Chinese memory giant ChangXin Technology (688825-CN) have recently signaled positive developments in their cooperation talks, with ChangXin stating its willingness to explore opportunities with top global customers, leading observers to believe the deal may be gradually clarifying. However, a partnership between Apple and a Chinese memory supplier could increase political sensitivity for Apple in the United States.

According to a report by Wccftech, Apple is currently seeking to expand its bargaining power on the memory supply side. In addition to major memory suppliers Micron (MU-US), Samsung Electronics (005930KS), SK Hynix (000660KS) and Kioxia, ChangXin Technology has also emerged as a potential partner.

On the other hand, U.S. officials are reported to be considering Apple’s potential collaboration with ChangXin as a bargaining chip in negotiations with China. President Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping are expected to meet during a visit to the United States at the end of the month, bringing the prospective deal into focus.

ChangXin recently issued a fresh signal regarding talks with Apple, saying: “We are open to exploring cooperation opportunities with top global customers. Our products now match leading suppliers worldwide in performance, quality and supply reliability.”

ChangXin is actively expanding capacity and expects to boost monthly output to roughly 300,000 wafers by the end of the year through three new 300‑mm fabs, averaging about 100,000 wafers per plant per month.
The company is also scaling up production focused on high‑bandwidth memory (HBM), aiming for about 50,000 wafers per month by the end of 2026.

ChangXin is building two additional fabs in Shanghai and Hefei; once completed, total monthly capacity will rise to 600,000 wafers, and at the current expansion pace the firm could surpass Micron’s production scale as early as 2030.
Beyond capacity growth, ChangXin’s memory technology continues to advance. It has entered mass production of LPDDR5X, begun manufacturing LPDDR6, and plans to start HBM3 production later this year.

Facing limits to process scaling, ChangXin is reportedly adopting High‑k Metal Gate (HKMG) technology, using materials such as hafnium oxide (HfO₂) instead of traditional silicon‑based dielectrics. This reduces leakage current and thermal loss, improves energy efficiency and supports higher computing speeds.
Even if Apple ultimately partners with ChangXin, analysts expect Apple will not rely exclusively on the Chinese supplier for the memory needed in the Chinese market.
Apple’s memory demand for the Chinese market is estimated at about 600 million GB, based on roughly 50 million devices per year each using an average of 12 GB of memory.
Given that ChangXin’s capacity is already booked through 2027 and utilization sits around 95%, Apple is likely to source only a portion of its Chinese‑market memory needs from ChangXin.

items.title: Anthropic放棄60億美元收購Decart！AI新創併購案告吹
items.title_en: Anthropic abandons $6 billion acquisition of Decart! AI startup merger falls through
paras: 人工智慧（AI）新創公司Decart原本傳出將獲Anthropic收購，但這項交易如今告吹。知情人士透露，Anthropic經過評估及盡職調查後，最終決定不再推進收購案，雙方未來仍可能尋求其他合作機會。
根據《彭博》報導，知情人士表示，Anthropic先前曾就收購Decart展開洽談，並進行相關盡職調查，不過最終選擇退出。Anthropic與Decart的代表均拒絕評論。
《彭博》8月曾報導，Anthropic正與Decart洽談收購事宜，交易金額約為60億美元，但當時尚未達成最終協議，交易仍存在破局可能。
Decart開發的軟體能協助晶片提升運作效率，進而降低AI訓練與運行的成本。
Anthropic很少進行大型收購，目前正投入大量資金取得運算能力，以開發新產品並服務客戶，為市場高度期待的華爾街上市做準備。
知情人士透露，該公司計畫透過首次公開募股（IPO）籌募的資金規模，可能達到SpaceX(SPCX-US) 的水準甚至更高。
（本文不開放合作夥伴轉載）
paras_en: AI startup Decart was originally reported to be acquired by Anthropic, but the deal has now collapsed. Insiders said that after evaluation and due diligence, Anthropic decided not to proceed with the acquisition, though the two parties may still explore other collaboration opportunities in the future.

According to Bloomberg, sources said Anthropic had previously entered talks to acquire Decart and conducted related due diligence, but ultimately chose to walk away. Representatives from both Anthropic and Decart declined to comment.
Bloomberg reported in August that Anthropic was in talks to buy Decart for about $6 billion, but no final agreement had been reached at that time and the deal remained at risk of falling apart.
Decart’s software helps chips operate more efficiently, thereby reducing the cost of AI training and inference.

Anthropic rarely makes large acquisitions; it is currently pouring substantial capital into securing compute power to develop new products and serve customers, in preparation for a highly anticipated Wall Street IPO.
Insiders disclosed that the company plans to raise an amount of capital through its initial public offering that could match or even exceed the scale of SpaceX (SPCX‑US).
(This article is not available for partner re‑publication)

items.title: 全球折疊機出貨有望年底破億 蘋果入場首年位居第二
items.title_en: Global Foldable Phone Shipments Expected to Top 100 Million by Year-End, Apple Ranks Second in First Year
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US) 周四（10日）凌晨將發布首款折疊iPhone，市調機構Counterpoint預估，全球折疊機累計出貨量將在今年底首度突破1億台，且蘋果入場首年即有望拿下四分之一市場。
Counterpoint Research周一最新發布的《折疊機市場預測》顯示，全球折疊機累計出貨量有望在2026年底跨過1億台關口。
自2019年首款商用折疊機問世以來，該品類用了八年時間跨越這道門檻。
Counterpoint的數據顯示，折疊機年度出貨增速將從2025年的18%升至2026年的24%，並於2027年進一步加速至37%；按此節奏，累計出貨量有望在三年內從1億台增至2億台。
2027年加速主要來自兩方面：一是蘋果將首次擁有完整銷售年份，疊加產能爬坡到位，折疊iPhone出貨量有望在2026年最多600萬台的基礎上翻番以上，份額升至40%，成為最大增量來源。
二是產業向更寬螢幕比例的內折疊形態遷移仍將延續，三星Galaxy Z Fold8早期市場迴響與華為Pura X Max銷售勢頭即是印證。
Counterpoint研究總監Tarun Pathak表示：「蘋果加入勢必加劇高階市場競爭，但折疊機在整體智慧手機市場中仍然只是很小一部分，這一品類的成長空間遠超當前出貨規模。」
據Counterpoint統計，目前折疊機型在整體智慧手機市場中的比率僅約2%，成長空間可觀。
目前折疊機的市場制約同樣明顯：售價仍是傳統直板機型的3倍左右，大眾化普及仍需數年。
Counterpoint預測，蘋果2026年折疊iPhone出貨量最高可達600萬台，對應全球折疊機市場25%份額，位居第二，僅次於三星的38%，高於華為的22%。
今年銷售窗口相對較短，蘋果能在進入該品類後如此迅速取得這一排名，意義重大。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) will unveil its first foldable iPhone early Thursday (the 10th). Research firm Counterpoint estimates that global cumulative foldable shipments will break the 100 million‑unit mark by the end of this year, and Apple could capture about a quarter of the market in its debut year.
Counterpoint Research’s latest “Foldable Phone Market Forecast” released on Monday shows global cumulative foldable shipments are expected to cross the 100 million‑unit threshold by the end of 2026.
Since the first commercial foldable phone launched in 2019, the category has taken eight years to reach this milestone.

Counterpoint’s data indicate that annual shipment growth will rise from 18% in 2025 to 24% in 2026 and accelerate further to 37% in 2027; at this pace cumulative shipments could climb from 100 million to 200 million units within three years.

The 2027 acceleration is expected from two factors: first, Apple will have a full sales year and production capacity will be in place, so foldable iPhone shipments could more than double the up‑to‑6 million units projected for 2026, lifting its share to 40% and becoming the largest source of incremental volume.

Second, the industry’s shift toward inward‑folding designs with wider screens will continue, as early market response to Samsung’s Galaxy Z Fold 8 and the sales momentum of Huawei’s Pura X Max demonstrate.

Counterpoint research director Tarun Pathak said: “Apple’s entry will inevitably intensify competition in the high‑end market, but foldables still represent only a very small portion of the overall smartphone market, and the growth potential of this category far exceeds current shipment volumes.”
According to Counterpoint, foldable models currently account for only about 2% of the overall smartphone market, indicating considerable growth potential.
The market constraints for foldables are also clear: prices remain roughly three times those of traditional slab phones, so mass adoption will still require several years.

Counterpoint forecasts that Apple’s foldable iPhone shipments could reach up to 6 million units in 2026, corresponding to a 25% share of the global foldable market, ranking second behind Samsung’s 38% and ahead of Huawei’s 22%.
This year’s sales window is relatively short, so Apple’s rapid climb to this ranking after entering the category is highly significant.

items.title: 特斯拉睽違19個月再降價 中國消費者還是買賬了
items.title_en: Tesla Cuts Prices Again After 19 Months, Chinese Consumers Still Buying
paras: 9月7日（周一）上午8點多，北京一家特斯拉(TSLA-US) 體驗店尚未正式營業，一筆新訂單已經進入系統。
該門市銷售人員，在其可以查看的訂單範圍內，當日上午全系車型新訂單接近20筆，數輛Model 3長續航版現車已被鎖定。熱門顏色和配置減少，部分現車可能提前售罄。
在另一家特斯拉門市，同樣出現了少有爆單現象。該門市店長說：「手機（消息）都爆了，熱搜都上了，現在都是要訂車的客戶。」
據《界面新聞》報導，特斯拉中國7日宣布，Model 3全系現車現金激勵人民幣（下同）5,000元，Model Y全系現車現金激勵1萬元，現金激勵直接抵扣尾款，官方指導價保持不變。
以此計算，Model 3和Model Y起售價分別降至22.25萬元和25.35萬元，達到全系歷史最低價。
現金激勵縮短了特斯拉潛在消費者的決策過程。此前零息和低息貸款將優惠分攤到長期月供，並受到貸款資質、首付比例等條件限制；尾款減免直接降低成交價格，還可與部分現有權益疊加。
此次優惠政策還疊加了現車和月底提車期限兩個限制條件，進一步壓縮了消費者觀望時間，促使一批近期購車需求在政策發布當天集中釋放。
特斯拉上一次在中國推出同類現車現金優惠是在2024年11月25日。當時部分Model Y現車尾款立減1萬元，活動延續至2025年1月31日。本輪政策距上一輪推出約21個月，距上一輪結束約19個月，適用範圍擴大到Model 3和Model Y全系現車。
特斯拉後續在華銷售策略更多集中在金融政策調整上。這能夠降低消費者月供門檻，同時維持公開售價，保持品牌調性。現金減免向消費者展示了更低成交價格，對短期訂單刺激更加直接，但也會相應減少單車收入。
特斯拉選擇在9月加入這一工具，與上海工廠季度交付節奏有關。上述門市店長說，這輪優惠的主要任務是拚第三季交付。
按照其所在門市接到的安排，國慶假期前後一段時間無法辦理交付，上海工廠進入下一季後將優先安排出口。可供中國國內集中交付的時間主要落在9月。
本輪限時現金激勵直接動因是中國國內市場的增長壓力。乘聯會的數據顯示，2026年1至7月，特斯拉中國累計零售約26.6萬輛，較一年前下降12.44%，其中Model 3銳減32.66%。
特斯拉同時受到豪華品牌和中國造車新勢力擠壓。近期寶馬新世代iX3以26.99萬元開放預訂，上汽奧迪AUDI E7X限時起售價為26.98萬元，兩款車型進入Model Y主要價格區間。
小米(01810-HK) 、理想(LI-US) (02015-HK) 、問界、極氪、樂道等品牌用更高配置、更強座艙和更快新車節奏，持續動搖特斯拉過去「默認選項」地位。過去特斯拉憑藉品牌號召力便能佔據上風，但這一優勢已越來越難彌補其在產品迭代和本土化體驗上的差距。
paras_en: On the morning of Monday, September 7, just after 8 a.m., a new order was already entered into the system at a Tesla (TSLA-US) experience store in Beijing that had not yet officially opened for business.

The sales staff at that store saw nearly 20 new orders for all models that morning, with several Model 3 Long‑Range vehicles already locked in. Popular colors and configurations are dwindling, and some inventory may sell out ahead of schedule.
At another Tesla showroom, a similarly rare surge of orders occurred. The store manager said, “Phones (messages) are blowing up, it’s trending, now it’s all customers wanting to order cars.”

According to Jiemian News, Tesla China announced on the 7th that cash incentives of RMB 5,000 for all in‑stock Model 3s and RMB 10,000 for all in‑stock Model Ys would be applied directly to the final payment, while the official guide price remains unchanged.
With those incentives, the starting prices of the Model 3 and Model Y fall to RMB 222,500 and RMB 253,500 respectively, the lowest historic prices across the entire line‑up.

The cash incentives shorten the decision‑making process for potential buyers. Previously, zero‑interest or low‑interest loans spread the discount over a longer monthly payment period and were subject to credit qualifications and down‑payment ratios; a direct reduction of the final payment lowers the transaction price outright and can be combined with some existing benefits.

This promotion also adds two constraints – the vehicle must be in stock and delivery must occur by the end of the month – further compressing the consumer’s waiting time and prompting a batch of pending purchase demand to be released on the day the policy was announced.

Tesla’s last similar in‑stock cash incentive in China was on November 25, 2024, when certain Model Y inventory received a RMB 10,000 reduction, an offer that lasted until January 31, 2025. This round comes about 21 months after the previous launch and roughly 19 months after that promotion ended, expanding the scope to all in‑stock Model 3 and Model Y vehicles.

Going forward, Tesla’s sales strategy in China will focus more on financial policy adjustments. This can lower the monthly payment threshold for consumers while keeping the list price unchanged, preserving the brand’s positioning. Cash reductions show consumers a lower transaction price, providing a more direct short‑term order stimulus, though they also reduce per‑vehicle revenue.

Tesla chose to introduce this tool in September to align with the delivery rhythm of its Shanghai factory’s quarterly schedule. The store manager said the main task of this round of incentives is to boost third‑quarter deliveries.

According to the store’s schedule, deliveries cannot be processed around the National Day holiday, and after the Shanghai plant moves into the next quarter it will prioritize exports. The window for concentrated domestic deliveries in China therefore falls mainly in September.

The immediate driver of this limited‑time cash incentive is growth pressure in the domestic Chinese market. Data from the China Passenger Car Association show that from January to July 2026, Tesla China’s cumulative retail deliveries were about 266,000 units, a 12.44% decline year‑over‑year, with Model 3 volumes plunging 32.66%.

Tesla is also being squeezed by luxury brands and new Chinese automakers. Recently, BMW’s new‑generation iX3 opened pre‑orders at RMB 269,900, and SAIC‑Audi’s AUDI E7X is limited‑time priced at RMB 269,800, both entering the primary price bracket of the Model Y.

Xiaomi (01810‑HK), Li Auto (LI‑US) (02015‑HK), WM Motor, Zeekr, Leapmotor and other brands are offering higher‑spec trims, stronger cabins and faster new‑model cycles, continuously eroding Tesla’s former “default option” status. Tesla once relied on brand appeal to dominate, but that advantage is increasingly hard to offset the gaps in product iteration and localized experience.

items.title: 川普再發聲安撫選民：戰勝伊朗後油價將「斷崖式下跌」　最終跌至每加侖2美元以下
items.title_en: Trump Says Oil Prices Will Plummet Below $2 per Gallon After Defeating Iran
paras: 美國總統川普周一(7日)在Truth Social上發表強硬言論，對於正在進行的美伊衝突以及全球能源市場前景做出高調預測。
川普在貼文中表示，在美國贏得與伊朗的戰爭後，全球油價及全美零售汽油價格將迎來「斷崖式下跌」，最終甚至會跌破每加侖2美元關口。「當我們贏得與伊朗的戰爭時，油價將會斷崖式下跌，就像其他所有東西都在下跌一樣(但跌得更多！)。油價將先降到每加侖3美元，最終會跌到2美元以下。這一切都將迅速發生，而且伊朗永遠不會擁有核武器。MAGA！」
這並非川普首次將中東軍事衝突與美國國內民生經濟直接掛鉤。自今年初美伊爆發衝突、荷姆茲海峽這一關鍵航道受阻以來，全球能源市場劇烈震盪，全美零售汽油均價一度飆升，近期也在高點徘徊，部分地區甚至出現創紀錄的燃料成本，這讓全美消費者和企業主背負沉重的通膨壓力。
面對美國國內對高油價的廣泛怨氣，川普醉心表態顯然意在安撫選民，試圖將當前的經濟陣痛塑造為實現長期安全與「能源紅利」的必要代價。
此前，川普曾表示，為了徹底消除德黑蘭的核威脅，短期內的能源價格上漲對美國和世界和平而言是「微不足道的代價」。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump posted a hard‑line statement on Truth Social on Monday (the 7th), offering bold predictions about the ongoing U.S.–Iran clash and the outlook for global energy markets.

In the post, Trump claimed that once the United States wins its war with Iran, global oil prices and U.S. retail gasoline prices will experience a “cliff‑drop,” eventually falling below the $2‑per‑gallon threshold. He said, “When we win the war with Iran, oil prices will plunge like everything else is falling (but even more!). Oil will first drop to $3 a gallon and eventually go under $2. All of this will happen quickly, and Iran will never have a nuclear weapon. MAGA!”

This is not the first time Trump has directly linked Middle‑East military conflict to the domestic U.S. economy. Since the U.S.–Iran confrontation erupted earlier this year and the critical Hormuz Strait was blocked, global energy markets have been wildly volatile, U.S. retail gasoline prices surged and have been hovering near recent highs, with some regions seeing record‑breaking fuel costs that have weighed heavily on American consumers and business owners amid inflation pressures.

Facing widespread domestic anger over high fuel prices, Trump’s fervent statements appear aimed at soothing voters, trying to frame the current economic pain as a necessary cost for long‑term security and an “energy dividend.”
Previously, Trump said that to fully eliminate Tehran’s nuclear threat, the short‑term rise in energy prices is a “trivial cost” for U.S. and world peace.

items.title: 美國期中選舉恐成AI投資「新瓶頸」！大摩密切關注「這幾場」選戰
items.title_en: U.S. Midterm Elections May Become New Bottleneck for AI Investment, Morgan Stanley Watches "These" Races Closely
paras: 全球科技巨頭為推動人工智慧（AI）發展，持續砸下鉅資興建資料中心，但隨著大型設施陸續進入地方社區，反對聲浪也逐漸升溫，部分計畫甚至因此延宕或取消。摩根士丹利近期警告，資料中心引發的地方反彈，可能成為AI投資熱潮面臨的新瓶頸。
根據《Business Insider》報導，摩根士丹利上週發布報告指出，該行正密切關注今年11月美國多場選舉，因相關選舉結果可能對未來資料中心建設產生影響。
摩根士丹利策略師Ariana Salvatore表示，自去年秋季相關議題開始浮現以來，該行便將其視為2026年選舉的重要切入點。不過，目前來看，資料中心政策風險仍主要集中在州與地方層級，尚未成為聯邦層面的主要問題。
隨著市場對AI交易的熱度持續升高，資料中心遭地方反對也逐漸受到金融業界關注。摩根士丹利近期已將地方反彈列為AI交易可能面臨的瓶頸之一，越來越多金融業人士開始將資料中心反彈視為AI投資題材的潛在風險。
美國總統川普也已介入這項爭議。他曾在Truth Social發文支持資料中心建設，認為大型資料中心能帶來經濟效益，並為美國鄉村地區創造利益。
不過，資料中心規模龐大，對部分經濟條件本就不佳的地區而言，也可能帶來沉重成本及重要資源消耗，使地方政府與居民對相關建設更加警戒。

摩根士丹利盯緊多場選舉　資料中心政策成競選議題

摩根士丹利認為，資料中心對AI交易的風險可能在2028年總統大選後進一步升高，但在此之前，該行已鎖定多場今年期中選舉相關競爭，因選舉結果可能影響部分已規劃中的資料中心計畫。
在眾議院選舉方面，摩根士丹利關注賓州第8選區共和黨Rob Bresnahan Jr.與民主黨Paige Cognetti的競爭。
Bresnahan今年6月提出法案，希望提高科技企業因地方分區及土地使用問題起訴社區的難度。其《地方控制保護法》（Local Control Protection Act）將限制資料中心開發商對反對相關建設的地方政府提起訴訟，但目前尚無共同提案人，法案也尚未離開委員會。
Cognetti則將資料中心議題納入競選訴求，但目前尚未提出相應的具體機制。
另一場受到關注的是密西根州第7選區，共和黨Tom Barrett對上民主黨William Lawrence。Lawrence支持資料中心暫停建設，Barrett則已提出多項法案，試圖限制資料中心可能造成的過度影響。
Lawrence支持由Bernie Sanders與Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez提出的《AI資料中心暫停法》（AI Data Center Moratorium Act），主張聯邦層級暫停資料中心建設。
Barrett則在8月20日提出《資料中心地方控制保護法》（Protecting Local Control of Data Centers Act）及《禁止資料中心保密協議法》（No Data Centers NDAs Act），相關措施均須透過聯邦立法才能實施。

參議院選戰升溫　德州、密西根成關注焦點

參議院方面，摩根士丹利將德州選戰列為觀察重點，由共和黨Ken Paxton對決民主黨James Talarico。
Talarico已將資料中心監管列為競選核心議題之一，並提出「資料中心問責計畫」（Hold Data Centers Accountable Plan），內容包括取消州銷售稅優惠、設定聯邦最低標準，以及要求資料中心採用封閉循環用水系統。
Paxton過去對資料中心相關議題反應較慢，但近期也提出降低資料中心負面影響的方案，包括支持取消相關稅務優惠、限制資料中心在鄉村地區選址，以及禁止中國科技。
密西根州則由共和黨Mike Rogers對決民主黨Abdul El-Sayed。Rogers在8月20日表態支持密西根州暫停資料中心建設1年，但強調並不支持聯邦層級全面禁止。
El-Sayed則對資料中心持較強烈批評態度，主張建立更嚴格的監管與分區制度，包括全面性的土地使用規範、地方否決權，以及要求資料中心與社區達成利益回饋協議。
不過，摩根士丹利指出，兩名候選人均無法單獨透過選舉結果直接實施密西根州的資料中心暫停措施。
俄亥俄州參議院選戰同樣受到關注，共和黨Jon Husted對上民主黨Sherrod Brown。
摩根士丹利表示，目前兩名候選人都沒有明確支持暫停資料中心建設。Husted認為資料中心選址屬於地方政府權限，而Brown則將矛頭指向資料中心相關稅務優惠。
Brown更曾將Husted形容為俄亥俄州資料中心議題的「代表人物」，但目前雙方都未明確主張暫停相關建設。
paras_en: Global tech giants continue to pour massive funds into building data centers to advance artificial intelligence (AI), but as large facilities enter local communities, opposition is growing, causing some projects to be delayed or cancelled. Morgan Stanley recently warned that local backlash against data centers could become a new bottleneck for the AI investment boom.

According to Business Insider, Morgan Stanley released a report last week noting that the firm is closely monitoring several U.S. elections in November, as the outcomes could affect future data‑center construction.

Morgan Stanley strategist Ariana Salvatore said that since the issue first surfaced in the fall of last year, the firm has treated it as a key angle for the 2026 election. However, for now the policy risk around data centers remains largely at the state and local level and has not yet become a major federal issue.

As market enthusiasm for AI trading rises, local opposition to data centers is drawing increasing attention from the financial sector. Morgan Stanley has recently listed local backlash as one of the potential bottlenecks for AI trading, and more finance professionals are viewing data‑center resistance as a possible risk to AI‑investment themes.

Former President Donald Trump has also weighed in on the controversy. He posted on Truth Social in support of data‑center construction, arguing that large facilities bring economic benefits and create value for rural America.

Nevertheless, data centers are massive projects that can impose heavy costs and significant resource consumption on regions already struggling economically, prompting local governments and residents to be more cautious about such developments.

Morgan Stanley sees data‑center policy risks potentially rising after the 2028 presidential election, but before then the firm has identified several midterm contests that could influence planned data‑center projects.
In the House races, Morgan Stanley is watching the contest in Pennsylvania’s 8th district between Republican Rob Bresnahan Jr. and Democrat Paige Cognetti.

Bresnahan introduced a bill in June aimed at making it harder for tech companies to sue communities over zoning and land‑use issues. His Local Control Protection Act would limit data‑center developers from suing local governments that oppose projects, but the bill currently has no co‑sponsor and has not left committee.
Cognetti has incorporated the data‑center issue into her campaign platform, though she has not yet proposed a concrete mechanism.

Another race under scrutiny is Michigan’s 7th district, where Republican Tom Barrett faces Democrat William Lawrence. Lawrence backs a pause on data‑center construction, while Barrett has introduced multiple bills seeking to curb the potential over‑impact of data centers.
Lawrence supports the AI Data Center Moratorium Act introduced by Bernie Sanders and Alexandria Ocasio‑Cortez, which calls for a federal‑level pause on data‑center builds.
Barrett on August 20 introduced the Protecting Local Control of Data Centers Act and the No Data Centers NDAs Act; both measures would require federal legislation to take effect.
In the Senate, Morgan Stanley is focusing on Texas, where Republican Ken Paxton squares off against Democrat James Talarico.

Talarico has made data‑center regulation a core campaign issue and proposed a Hold Data Centers Accountable Plan that would eliminate state sales‑tax breaks, set federal minimum standards, and require data centers to use closed‑loop water‑recycling systems.

Paxton has historically been slower on data‑center issues, but recently offered proposals to reduce negative impacts, including ending tax incentives, restricting rural siting, and banning Chinese technology firms.

In Michigan, Republican Mike Rogers faces Democrat Abdul El‑Sayed. Rogers announced on August 20 his support for a one‑year state‑level pause on data‑center construction, while emphasizing he does not back a full federal ban.

El‑Sayed takes a stronger stance against data centers, advocating stricter regulation and zoning, comprehensive land‑use rules, local veto rights, and requiring data‑center operators to negotiate community benefit agreements.
Morgan Stanley notes that neither candidate could unilaterally implement a Michigan data‑center pause through election results alone.
Ohio’s Senate race also draws attention, with Republican Jon Husted against Democrat Sherrod Brown.

Morgan Stanley says neither candidate has explicitly supported pausing data‑center construction. Husted views site selection as a local‑government matter, while Brown points criticism at data‑center tax incentives.
Brown has even called Husted the “figurehead” of Ohio’s data‑center issue, but both sides have yet to formally advocate halting related projects.

items.title: 美股亮起155年僅見兩次的警訊 巴菲特一句話示警
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks Light Up a Warning Seen Only Twice in 155 Years, Buffett Issues a Cautionary Remark
paras: 標普 500 指數過去幾年強勢攀升，人工智慧（AI）類股更成為這波多頭行情的領頭羊。過去三個曆年，這項知名指標累計上漲 78%，今年漲勢大致延續，全年升幅可望達到 13%。
這波行情讓許多投資人斬獲頗豐，但全球最成功的投資人之一，卻不太滿意目前看到的景象。
「股神」巴菲特執掌波克夏海瑟威（Berkshire Hathaway）長達 60 年，締造持續超越大盤的亮眼績效。這位億萬富豪已於今年初卸下執行長職務，但仍擔任董事長，並持續參與投資決策。
隨著股市亮起 155 年來僅出現過兩次的警訊，巴菲特也提高警覺。在此背景下，這位投資傳奇向投資人發出直白警告。
錯過當年的輝達？罕見訊號再度浮現
2009 年，一項「加倍押注」訊號曾在當時名不見經傳的晶片製造商輝達(NVDA-US) 身上出現。如今，這項「完全信服」訊號多年來首度再現，指向一家規模僅有輝達百分之一的公司。
首先簡單回顧巴菲特的投資策略。巴菲特素有「奧馬哈先知」之稱，他之所以能創造驚人報酬，關鍵在於無論市場環境如何變化，始終堅守一套投資原則。
巴菲特主張以合理價格買進優質股票，尤其偏好逢低撿便宜，並長期持有。投資可口可樂便是典型案例。他在 1980 年代末期開始買進這家飲料巨擘的股票，此後一路持有至今。事實上，可口可樂(KO-US) 目前仍是波克夏海瑟威前五大持股之一。
這位頂尖投資人也不容易受到他人影響，因此不會盲目追隨市場趨勢。在多頭市場中，他不會急著追買當紅股票；在空頭市場中，也不會倉促逃離股市。
事實上，巴菲特經常逆勢而行，尋找暫時失寵、或尚未獲得市場青睞的優質股票。他的投資邏輯，是在價格合理時及早布局，待其他投資人日後發掘這些股票的價值，再從中受益。
AI熱潮推升股市估值、席勒本益比突破41倍
再來看看當前市場環境，以及巴菲特近期提出的警告。如前所述，在 AI 革命與整體偏多氛圍推動下，標普 500 指數大幅上漲。與此同時，通膨升溫疑慮與伊朗局勢動盪等逆風，也曾一度壓抑市場動能。
不過，市場整體持續走高，已帶來一項格外值得注意的結果：股市正亮起 155 年來僅出現過兩次的警訊，也就是股票已處於歷史高價。
標普 500 指數的席勒循環調整本益比（Shiller CAPE）已突破 41 倍。過去只有一次達到這種水準，發生在網路泡沫時期。
席勒循環調整本益比是具參考價值的估值指標，透過比較股價與過去 10 年每股盈餘的關係，降低景氣波動造成的影響。
如今這項指標顯示，美股估值已升至極高水準，而歷史經驗顯示，股市觸及類似高檔後，往往會出現回落。
就在幾個月前，巴菲特接受 CNBC 訪問時表示，許多市場參與者正在「賭博」，而這種「賭博氣氛」已升至高峰。
巴菲特說：「如果你買賣的是一天到期的選擇權，那既不是投資，也不是投機，而是賭博。」
市場上的這股風氣，加上目前居高不下的估值，可能使股市重演過去常見的走勢，也就是由高檔向下修正。
現在該買進標普500指數嗎
這對當前投資人意味著什麼？這並不代表投資人應該逃離市場。相反地，一如往常，買進股票前仍應評估其估值、公司的財務體質，以及長期發展前景。
只要確實做好這些功課，並抱持長期持有的決心，就等於採取巴菲特式投資策略，也可能在任何市場環境中找到機會。
在買進標普 500 指數前，不妨先思考以下一點。
Motley Fool旗下 Stock Advisor 分析團隊近期選出他們認為目前最值得投資人買進的 10 檔股票，標普 500 指數並未入選。這 10 檔股票未來幾年可能創造驚人報酬。
以網飛(NFLX-US) 為例，該股於 2004 年 12 月 17 日入選這份名單。若當時依照建議投入 1,000 美元，如今資產將達到 421,997 美元。輝達則在 2005 年 4 月 15 日入選，當時投入的 1,000 美元，如今將成長至 1,413,876 美元。
值得注意的是，Stock Advisor 的平均總報酬率達 978%，遠高於標普 500 指數的 213%。投資人可透過 Stock Advisor 查看最新十大推薦名單，並加入由個人投資人為個人投資人打造的投資社群。
paras_en: The S&P 500 has surged strongly in recent years, with AI stocks leading the current bull market. Over the past three calendar years, this well‑known index has risen 78%, and this year’s rally appears set to continue, with a full‑year gain potentially reaching 13%.
The rally has rewarded many investors handsomely, but one of the world’s most successful investors is less satisfied with what he sees today.

‘The Oracle of Omaha’ Warren Buffett has run Berkshire Hathaway for 60 years, delivering performance that consistently outpaces the market. The billionaire stepped down as CEO earlier this year but remains chairman and continues to take part in investment decisions.
With the market flashing a warning that has only appeared twice in the past 155 years, Buffett is on high alert. Against this backdrop, the investing legend has issued a blunt warning to investors.
Missed Nvidia back then? A rare signal re‑emerges

In 2009 a “double‑down” signal showed up on the then‑obscure chipmaker Nvidia (NVDA‑US). Today that same “full‑conviction” signal has resurfaced for the first time in years, pointing to a company only about one‑percent the size of Nvidia.
First, a brief recap of Buffett’s investment approach. Known as the “Omaha Prophet,” Buffett’s extraordinary returns stem from sticking to a core set of principles regardless of market conditions.

Buffett advocates buying quality stocks at reasonable prices, especially favoring bargains on dips and holding them for the long term. His investment in Coca‑Cola is a classic example. He began buying the beverage giant’s shares in the late 1980s and has held them ever since. In fact, Coca‑Cola (KO‑US) remains one of Berkshire Hathaway’s top‑five holdings.

The legendary investor is not easily swayed by others, so he does not blindly follow market trends. In a bull market he won’t rush to chase hot stocks; in a bear market he won’t hastily flee equities.

In fact, Buffett often goes against the grain, seeking temporarily out‑of‑favor or still‑unappreciated quality stocks. His logic is to position early when prices are reasonable, then profit as other investors later discover the stocks’ value.
AI hype lifts market valuations, Shiller CAPE tops 41‑times

Now let’s look at the current market environment and Buffett’s recent warning. As noted, the AI revolution and an overall bullish sentiment have driven the S&P 500 sharply higher. At the same time, inflation worries and geopolitical turbulence in Iran have at times dampened market momentum.

Nevertheless, the market’s overall upward trajectory has produced a noteworthy outcome: the stock market is flashing a warning that has only occurred twice in the past 155 years, meaning stocks are at historically high levels.
The S&P 500’s Shiller cyclically‑adjusted price‑to‑earnings ratio (CAPE) has broken above 41‑times earnings. It has only reached that level once before, during the dot‑com bubble.
The Shiller CAPE is a useful valuation metric that compares current prices to earnings over the past ten years, smoothing out business‑cycle volatility.
Today the indicator shows U.S. equities are priced at an extremely high level, and history suggests that markets tend to pull back after reaching such lofty valuations.
A few months ago, Buffett told CNBC that many market participants are “gambling,” and that this gambling atmosphere has peaked.
Buffett said, “If you’re trading options that expire in one day, that’s neither investing nor speculation—it’s gambling.”
This prevailing mindset, combined with persistently lofty valuations, could cause the market to repeat a familiar pattern of correcting from lofty peaks.
Should you buy the S&P 500 now?

What does this mean for today’s investors? It does not mean they should flee the market. On the contrary, as always, buying stocks still requires evaluating valuation, a company’s financial health, and long‑term prospects.
If you do the homework and commit to holding for the long term, you are essentially following a Buffett‑style strategy, which can uncover opportunities in any market environment.
Before buying the S&P 500, consider this point.

Motley Fool’s Stock Advisor team recently selected the ten stocks they believe are the best buys right now, and the S&P 500 did not make the list. Those ten picks could generate spectacular returns over the next few years.

Take Netflix (NFLX‑US) as an example: it was added to the list on December 17 2004. An investment of $1,000 at that time would now be worth $421,997. Nvidia made the list on April 15 2005; a $1,000 investment then would have grown to $1,413,876 today.

Note that Stock Advisor’s average total return is 978%, far outpacing the S&P 500’s 213%. Investors can view the latest top‑ten recommendations on Stock Advisor and join a community built by individual investors for individual investors.

items.title: 中國8月出口年增25%優於預期，半導體與汽車需求強勁、但企業獲利仍承壓
items.title_en: China's August Exports Grow 25% YoY, Outpacing Expectations; Strong Semiconductor and Auto Demand, Yet Corporate Profits Remain Pressured
paras: 2026年09月08日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 中國8月出口成長加快，年增率達25.0%，優於市場預期，半導體、高科技產品與中國製汽車需求強勁，持續支撐出口表現。不過，在出口規模快速擴大的同時，部分製造業仍面臨內需偏弱、產能擴張及價格競爭等問題，出口增加尚未全面轉化為獲利成長。
中國海關總署周二公布數據顯示，以美元計價，中國8月出口金額達4,014.4億美元，年增率為25.0%，高於7月的23.9%，也優於經濟學家預估的23.8%。儘管受到極端天候影響，半導體及其他高科技產品需求仍保持強勁，加上中國製汽車出口增加，帶動整體出口成長。
其中，中國8月對美國出口年增34.4%至425億美元，較7月的316億美元大幅增加。中美兩國領導人預計本月稍晚舉行會晤，後續雙邊貿易政策及關稅變化將是市場關注重點。
累計2026年前8個月，中國出口年增19.3%至2.92兆美元，顯示海外市場仍是中國製造業重要的需求來源。
進口方面，中國8月進口年增率為28.2%，高於7月的27.5%，但略低於市場預期的29.1%。8月貿易順差擴大至1,191億美元，高於7月的1,125億美元，但略低於經濟學家預估的1,194億美元。
出口快速成長的背後，中國部分製造業正面臨內需不足與產能持續擴張的問題，企業因此積極開拓海外市場。2026年上半年，中國太陽能電池、鋰離子電池及電動車等「新三樣」產品出口年增52%，達1,160億美元；同期中國電動車製造商出口230萬輛，已接近2025全年250萬輛的出口規模。
不過，出貨量增加並未同步改善企業獲利。2026年上半年，中國汽車製造商整體利潤年減20%至1,950億元人民幣，利潤率降至3.8%。數據顯示，中國車廠透過海外市場擴大銷售及消化產能，但激烈的價格競爭仍持續壓縮獲利空間。

paras_en: 2026-09-08 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – China’s export growth accelerated in August, with a year‑on‑year increase of 25.0%, beating market expectations. Demand for semiconductors, high‑tech products and Chinese‑made automobiles remained robust, continuing to support export performance. However, even as export volumes expand rapidly, some manufacturing sectors still face weak domestic demand, capacity expansion and price competition, so the export surge has not yet fully translated into profit growth.

China’s customs authority released data on Tuesday showing that, measured in US dollars, August export value reached $401.44 billion, a 25.0% year‑on‑year rise, up from July’s 23.9% and above economists’ forecast of 23.8%. Despite extreme weather, demand for semiconductors and other high‑tech goods stayed strong, and higher exports of Chinese‑made cars also lifted overall export growth.

In August, China’s exports to the United States grew 34.4% year‑on‑year to $42.5 billion, a sharp jump from July’s $31.6 billion. The two leaders are expected to meet later this month, and any subsequent changes in bilateral trade policy and tariffs will be closely watched by the market.

For the first eight months of 2026, cumulative Chinese exports rose 19.3% year‑on‑year to $2.92 trillion, indicating that overseas markets remain a vital source of demand for China’s manufacturing sector.

On the import side, August imports grew 28.2% year‑on‑year, higher than July’s 27.5% but slightly below the market expectation of 29.1%. The trade surplus widened to $119.1 billion in August, up from $112.5 billion in July, but a touch below the economists’ estimate of $119.4 billion.

Behind the rapid export growth, parts of China’s manufacturing base are confronting weak domestic demand and ongoing capacity expansion, prompting firms to aggressively pursue overseas markets. In the first half of 2026, exports of the “new three” – solar cells, lithium‑ion batteries and electric vehicles – jumped 52% year‑on‑year to $116 billion; during the same period Chinese EV manufacturers shipped 2.3 million vehicles, approaching the full‑year 2025 export target of 2.5 million units.

Nevertheless, higher shipment volumes have not translated into better profitability. In the first half of 2026, the overall profit of Chinese automobile manufacturers fell 20% year‑on‑year to RMB 195 billion, with profit margins slipping to 3.8%. The data show that while Chinese carmakers are expanding sales abroad and absorbing capacity, intense price competition continues to compress profit margins.

items.title: 歐盟為鋼材進口管制鋪路10月起追溯熔鑄國，2027年連動配額
items.title_en: EU Lays Groundwork for Steel Import Controls, Retroactive to October 2026 and Linked Quotas by 2027
paras: 2026年09月08日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 自2026年10月1日起，歐盟將要求納管進口鋼材申報熔煉與鑄造國，表面上是增加供應鏈溯源要求，但更重要的意義，在於歐盟開始系統性掌握進口鋼材真正的上游來源，為未來可能採取更精準的來源別配額與進口管制預作準備。
所謂熔鑄國，是指鋼或鐵最初形成液態、再鑄造成固體的所在地。相較於出口國或最後加工國，熔鑄國更能反映鋼材真正的上游生產來源。新規要求進口商提供熔鑄國與爐號證據，實施首年可使用符合條件的替代文件，但仍須接受查驗；自2027年10月起，替代文件只能作為鋼廠測試證明的補充資料。
這項制度的關鍵，在於歐盟未來將有能力辨識一批進口鋼材究竟來自哪個國家的鋼廠，而非僅依最後加工地或出口地判斷來源。即使鋼材經第三國加工、轉售或重新出口，只要熔鑄資訊可以一路追溯，歐盟便能掌握其最初生產來源，降低透過第三國加工或轉口改變產品表面原產地所造成的資訊落差。
自2027年10月起，熔鑄資訊將納入各國配額分配考量；歐盟執委會並須在2028年6月底前評估，是否將熔鑄國進一步作為享有配額的依據。換言之，2026年開始要求申報來源，後續再將來源資訊與配額制度連結，政策重點已從單純「知道鋼材從哪裡來」，逐步走向「依真正來源決定鋼材能以何種條件進入歐盟市場」。

paras_en: On September 8, 2026 (Yōu Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Starting October 1, 2026, the EU will require importers of steel to declare the country of melting and casting. On the surface this adds a supply‑chain traceability requirement, but the more important implication is that the EU will begin to systematically track the true upstream source of imported steel, preparing for future, more precise source‑based quotas and import restrictions.

The term “melting‑casting country” refers to the location where steel or iron is first turned into liquid and then cast into solid form. Compared with the exporting country or the final processing country, the melting‑casting country better reflects the genuine upstream production source of the steel. The new rule obliges importers to provide evidence of the melting‑casting country and furnace number; in the first year, qualifying alternative documents may be used but are still subject to inspection. From October 2027 onward, alternative documents can only serve as supplementary evidence for steel‑mill test certification.

The crux of the system is that the EU will later be able to identify exactly which country’s steel mills a batch of imported steel originates from, rather than relying solely on the final processing or export location. Even if the steel is processed, resold, or re‑exported by a third country, as long as the melting‑casting information can be traced throughout the chain, the EU can pinpoint its original production source, reducing information gaps caused by third‑country processing or trans‑shipment that obscure the product’s true origin.

From October 2027, melting‑casting information will be taken into account in each country’s quota allocation; the European Commission must assess by the end of June 2028 whether the melting‑casting country should be used as a basis for quota entitlement. In other words, the requirement to declare origin starts in 2026, and the subsequent linking of that information to the quota system shifts the policy focus from merely “knowing where the steel comes from” to “determining under what conditions steel can enter the EU market based on its true source.”

items.title: 國際大行狂拉警報！法國興業銀行：美債10年期殖利率升破5.5% 股市將受重創
items.title_en: Major Global Banks Sound the Alarm! Societe Generale: 10-Year U.S. Treasury Yield Over 5.5% Will Slam Stock Markets
paras: 愈來愈多國際大行就美債殖利率攀漲對股市的衝擊發出警告，法國興業銀行最新加入這一行列，該行全球資產配置主管Alain Bokobza表示，10年期美債殖利率升至5.5%，恐為借貸成本壓倒獲利增長、進而壓縮估值的臨界點。
Bokobza出具最新研報指出，今年全球企業獲利預期大幅上調，因此即便殖利率走高，股票風險溢價並未坍塌，「股票現在並不比年初更貴」，但一旦10年期美債殖利率觸及5.5%，獲利上調將不足以支撐現有估值，即「股票開始受到衝擊」的水平。
他還預期，聯準會(Fed)與歐洲央行(ECB)後續升息幅度溫和，不足以打斷經濟周期，他將大趨勢形容為名義GDP的「長期上升」，動力包括德日財政支出高企、通膨頑固，以及AI基建帶來的資本需求激增。
近期債市重新主導股市情緒。美伊衝突推高油價，叠加央行鷹派信號、財政憂慮及AI資本開支爭奪資金，10年期美債收益率目前接近4.78%，上周一度觸及4.82%，創2023年以來新高。
摩根大通與巴克萊均視5%為關鍵心理關口。摩根大通全球投資策略主管Grace Peters警告，觸及5%恐觸發「膝反應」，美股面臨5%至8%回調壓力；巴克萊歐亞股票策略主管Emmanuel Cau亦表憂慮。
洛克菲勒國際董事長Ruchir Sharma更指出，美債規模已破40兆美元，若殖利率「決定性突破5%」的網路泡沫時代以來的區間上沿，AI泡沫可能破裂。
paras_en: More and more major international banks are warning that rising U.S. Treasury yields could hit equity markets, and France's Societe Generale has now joined the chorus. The bank’s global asset‑allocation head Alain Bokobza said a 10‑year Treasury yield that climbs to 5.5% could become the tipping point where borrowing costs outweigh profit growth and compress valuations.

Bokobza’s latest research note says this year’s global corporate‑profit outlook has been sharply upgraded, so even with higher yields the equity risk premium has not collapsed – “stocks are not more expensive now than at the start of the year.” However, once the 10‑year yield hits 5.5%, the profit upgrades will be insufficient to sustain current multiples, and “stocks will start to feel the pain.”

He also expects the Fed and the ECB to keep any further rate hikes modest, not enough to break the economic cycle. He describes the overarching trend as a “long‑term rise” in nominal GDP, driven by high fiscal spending in Germany and Japan, stubborn inflation, and a surge in capital demand from AI‑related infrastructure spending.

Bond markets have recently taken the lead in shaping market sentiment. The Israel‑Iran conflict has pushed oil prices higher, and combined with hawkish central‑bank signals, fiscal worries and AI capital‑spending battles for cash, the 10‑year Treasury yield is now near 4.78% and touched 4.82% last week, a peak not seen since 2023.

JPMorgan and Barclays both see 5% as a key psychological threshold. JPMorgan’s global investment strategy head Grace Peters warned that hitting 5% could trigger a “knee‑jerk reaction,” exposing U.S. equities to a 5%‑to‑8% pull‑back, and Barclays Asia‑Europe equities head Emmanuel Cau echoed the concern.

Rockefeller International chairman Ruchir Sharma added that U.S. debt now exceeds $40 trillion, and if yields decisively break above the 5% upper bound that has defined the internet‑bubble era, the AI bubble could also burst.

items.title: 安謀催生實體AI生態系 慧友躋身合作夥伴搶攻2000億美元運算商機
items.title_en: Arm Fuels Physical AI Ecosystem; Taiwan's Huiyou Joins Partners to Chase $200 Billion Computing Opportunity
paras: 矽智財大廠安謀(ARM-US)於9月8日正式發表Arm實體AI全面設計生態系計畫，宣布將Arm Total Design拓展至實體AI與機器人領域，串聯全球80多家橫跨技術堆疊的合作夥伴。台灣安控廠慧友(5484-TW)也名列生態系夥伴名單中，在發表會現場主舞台夥伴牆上正式亮相，並被歸類在致動與感測關鍵層級，展現其從傳統工控轉型至高階AI視覺辨識的實力。
安謀評估實體AI所涵蓋的全球經濟活動規模達數兆美元，至2030年左右可望形成每年2000億美元的運算商機，去年相關出貨量更已突破20億套。安謀此次串聯的生態系夥伴涵蓋AWS、Hugging Face、恩智浦與西門子等國際巨頭，而作為台廠的慧友，在打入輝達的機器人生態系後，藉由深耕多年的視覺感測解決方案，同樣成為安謀的實體AI生態系夥伴。
在實體落地應用方面，慧友以感知、理解、決策與行動為架構，將核心視覺監控與邊緣運算技術拓展至自主機器人領域。除了中階自主決策機械手臂已於歐美展開物流與食品分級篩選應用外，搭載高階運算模組的旗艦機種更順利打入歐美供應鏈，投入最後一哩路配送的機器狗終端設備。
慧友目前透過長期深耕的車載專案作為堅實基底，穩定的車隊更新需求為公司挹注穩健現金流。在車用基礎支持下，慧友全面推進AI視覺、機器人運算控制器與半導體設備相關訂單，本季專案出貨動能持續增溫，全年營運目標力拚全面轉虧為盈。
paras_en: Arm, the leading silicon IP company, announced on September 8 its Arm Physical AI end‑to‑end design ecosystem, extending Arm Total Design into physical AI and robotics and linking more than 80 partners across the technology stack. Taiwan’s industrial‑control maker Huiyou (5484‑TW) is listed among the ecosystem partners, appearing on the main‑stage partner wall at the launch and classified in the actuation and sensing tier, showcasing its transition from traditional industrial control to advanced AI visual recognition.

Arm estimates the global economic activity covered by physical AI to be in the trillions of dollars, with an annual $200 billion computing market expected around 2030 and shipments already exceeding 2 billion units last year. The ecosystem includes international giants such as AWS, Hugging Face, NXP and Siemens, and Huiyou, after entering Nvidia’s robot ecosystem, leverages its long‑standing visual‑sensing solutions to become an Arm physical‑AI partner as well.

In concrete applications, Huiyou builds on perception, understanding, decision‑making and action to extend its core visual monitoring and edge‑computing technologies into autonomous robots. Mid‑range autonomous decision‑making robotic arms are already deployed in logistics and food‑sorting in Europe and the U.S., while a flagship model equipped with a high‑end compute module has entered the European‑American supply chain, powering robot‑dog devices for last‑mile delivery.

Huiyou’s solid foundation comes from long‑term automotive projects that provide steady cash flow through regular fleet upgrades. With this automotive base, the company is pushing AI vision, robot compute controllers and semiconductor‑equipment orders, with project shipments gaining momentum this quarter and a full‑year goal of turning a profit after a loss.

items.title: 蘋果優質客戶服務神話破滅？M4 MacBook Pro修6次仍故障、曾承諾換機卻沒下文
items.title_en: Apple's Premium Customer Service Myth Shattered? M4 MacBook Pro Repaired Six Times Still Faulty, Promised Replacement Never Materialized
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US) 一向以客服服務受到消費者肯定，但近日一名M4 MacBook Pro用戶卻遇上截然不同的經歷。這名用戶表示，自己的14吋M4 MacBook Pro歷經多次維修仍無法正常運作，蘋果客服甚至曾以書面確認將為他更換整台電腦，後續卻遲遲沒有履行承諾。
根據《Wccftech》報導，Reddit網友Abdallah透露，他持有的14吋M4 MacBook Pro雖然僅是前一代機型，卻已接受多次硬體維修，包括兩度更換主機板、換過顯示器，以及上蓋角度感測器。
由於電腦在使用時仍出現異常，例如執行遊戲時速度緩慢，Abdallah向蘋果客服尋求協助。蘋果客服一名資深顧問後來透過官方電子郵件通知他，表示將更換一台新的M4 MacBook Pro。
根據蘋果當時提供的說明，由於相同規格的機型預計要到9月才會補貨，因此新機將在9月寄出。然而，當更換時間到來後，Abdallah多次透過電子郵件聯繫，卻未獲得實質回覆。
在沒有其他辦法的情況下，他甚至寄信給前蘋果執行長庫克（Tim Cook），試圖進一步升級處理這起客訴。
事件曝光後，也在Reddit引發討論。有網友認為，蘋果既然已向客戶提供書面協議，明確承諾更換產品，就應履行對客戶作出的承諾。
不過，另一名網友「TheRyznhawk」指出，蘋果通常不會直接更換MacBook，能夠符合換機條件的產品主要是iPhone、iPad及其他配件。
他表示，MacBook可以透過不同零組件重新組裝，因此只有在少數特殊情況下才會直接提供整機更換。
TheRyznhawk也提到，即使這款M4 MacBook Pro已經歷6次維修，他仍不認為這代表該產品應獲得特殊待遇。
不過，這也引發另一項疑問：如果只是一般硬體故障，為何蘋果客服經過6次維修後，仍無法讓這台MacBook正常運作？或許代表電腦可能存在尚未被找出的其他硬體問題。
雖然部分網友的回應可能讓Abdallah感到失望，但也有人鼓勵他持續向蘋果反映，直到問題獲得解決。
原文也提及，過去確實曾出現蘋果提供升級換機的案例。例如，一名用戶原本使用M2 Max MacBook Pro，最後獲得M5 Max MacBook Pro作為替換機，並額外取得部分商店抵用額度；另一名使用2019年英特爾(INTC-US) 處理器MacBook的消費者，則曾在無需額外付費的情況下獲得M5 MacBook Pro。
整體而言，蘋果過去曾出現讓消費者感受到優質客服服務的案例，但此次M4 MacBook Pro用戶在多次維修後仍無法解決問題，加上蘋果先前曾書面承諾換機卻未進一步落實，使事件受到關注。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) has long been praised for its customer service, but recently an M4 MacBook Pro user experienced a completely different story. The user says his 14‑inch M4 MacBook Pro underwent multiple repairs yet still could not operate properly, and Apple customer support even confirmed in writing that they would replace the entire computer, but the promise was never fulfilled.

According to a report by Wccftech, Reddit user Abdallah disclosed that his 14‑inch M4 MacBook Pro, although only a previous‑generation model, has already undergone several hardware repairs, including two motherboard replacements, a screen swap, and a replacement of the lid‑angle sensor.

Because the computer continued to exhibit issues during use—such as sluggish performance when gaming—Abdallah sought help from Apple support. A senior Apple advisor later notified him via official email that a new M4 MacBook Pro would be sent as a replacement.

Apple’s explanation at the time stated that the same‑spec model would not be restocked until September, so the new unit would be shipped in September. However, when the replacement time arrived, Abdallah sent multiple follow‑up emails but received no substantive response.
With no other recourse, he even wrote to former Apple CEO Tim Cook in an attempt to further elevate the complaint.

The incident’s exposure sparked discussion on Reddit. Some commenters argued that since Apple had provided a written agreement explicitly promising a replacement, the company should honor its commitment to the customer.
However, another Reddit user, “TheRyznhawk,” pointed out that Apple typically does not replace MacBooks directly; replacement eligibility usually applies to iPhones, iPads, and other accessories.
He explained that MacBooks can be reassembled from individual components, so a full‑unit replacement is only offered in rare, special cases.
TheRyznhawk also noted that even though this M4 MacBook Pro had undergone six repairs, he does not believe that alone warrants special treatment for the product.

Nevertheless, this raises another question: if it is merely a standard hardware failure, why was Apple unable to get the MacBook functioning properly after six repairs? It may indicate that the computer has other, as‑yet‑undetected hardware issues.
While some users’ responses may have disappointed Abdallah, others encouraged him to keep reporting the issue to Apple until it is resolved.

The original article also mentioned past instances where Apple did provide upgrade replacements. For example, a user originally using an M2 Max MacBook Pro eventually received an M5 Max MacBook Pro as a replacement, along with some store credit; another consumer with a 2019 Intel (INTC-US)‑based MacBook obtained an M5 MacBook Pro without any additional cost.

Overall, Apple has historically had cases that made consumers feel they received premium customer service, but this M4 MacBook Pro user’s problem remains unresolved after multiple repairs, and Apple’s prior written promise to replace the unit was never acted upon, drawing attention to the issue.

items.title_en: Calling Into a Major Optical Communications Manufacturer! Goldman Sachs Significantly Raises Optical Module Forecast: 2028 Market Size Projected at $148.5 Billion
paras: 高盛最新全球光模組報告大幅上調2026至2028年市場規模，預計分別達約677億、1314億和1485億美元，較此前預測上調33%、81%和115%，出貨量分別達5.48億、6.91億和7.29億隻，較此前預測分別上調21%、31%和31%。

高盛預估，800G及以上光模組的2026至2028年出貨量分別達7822萬、1.44億和1.71億隻，2026年增率166%、2027年增率84%，對應市場規模分別約452億、1075億和1295億美元，三年的年複合成長率(CAGR)約69%。
800G出貨在明年見頂於4948萬隻後小幅回落，1.6T由3283萬隻增至7136萬隻，3.2T則從2027年2304萬隻躍升至2028年6773萬隻。
按金額計算，3.2T將由2027年346億美元升至2028年813億美元，佔全球市場價值約55%。
受惠於整機櫃與ASIC雙引擎，AI伺服器正加速向整機櫃系統傾斜。輝達GB300已將GPU層升至800G、Leaf與Spine層採1.6T，Rubin及Rubin Ultra續向1.6T、3.2T遷移。全球AI整機櫃出貨預計由2025年1.9萬櫃增至2026年5.5萬櫃、2027年10.5萬櫃、2028年16.3萬櫃。
與此同時，ASIC佔全球AI晶片比重預計由2026年50%升至2028年55%，其光互連需求不亞於GPU系統。
高盛還上調單顆AI晶片的光模組用量：Rubin Ultra每顆GPU的1.6T由0個升至2個、3.2T由3個升至5個，谷歌TPU v9每顆晶片2027下半年至2028上半年用量為12個1.6T，2028下半年對應6個3.2T。
成本方面，1.6T矽光模組用4顆70mW連續波雷射器，價值量15至20美元，遠低於EML方案的約160美元，預計800G矽光滲透率約60%，1.6T與3.2T約80%，CPO則仍處初期，2026至2028年出貨72萬、853萬和1625萬，滲透率1%、6%和9%。值得注意的是，高盛下調2026年預測33%，卻上調2028年105%。
此外，儘管800G、1.6T同代產品價格逐年下滑，但受高速產品佔比提升拉動，行業整體均價仍將由123美元升至190美元和204美元。
目前，高盛對光模組與光引擎廠商中際旭創、FOCI、LandMark、VPEC及設備廠商羅博特科給予「買進」評等。
paras_en: Goldman Sachs' latest global optical module report sharply raises the market size for 2026‑2028, forecasting roughly $67.7 billion, $131.4 billion and $148.5 billion respectively—up 33%, 81% and 115% from previous estimates—and shipment volumes of 548 million, 691 million and 729 million units, up 21%, 31% and 31% from earlier forecasts.

Goldman notes that this upward revision is not driven solely by the growth in AI server counts; the key factor is the continued shift toward high‑speed networking, coupled with an increase in the number of optical modules required per GPU or ASIC, propelling rapid scaling of 800 Gb, 1.6 Tb and even 3.2 Tb modules.

Goldman estimates shipments of 800 Gb and larger optical modules will reach 78.22 million, 144 million and 171 million units in 2026‑2028, with year‑over‑year growth of 166% in 2026 and 84% in 2027, corresponding to market sizes of about $45.2 billion, $107.5 billion and $129.5 billion, and a three‑year compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of roughly 69%.

After peaking at 49.48 million units next year, 800 Gb shipments will dip slightly, while 1.6 Tb shipments will rise from 32.83 million to 71.36 million, and 3.2 Tb shipments will jump from 23.04 million in 2027 to 67.73 million in 2028.
In dollar terms, 3.2 Tb revenue will climb from $34.6 billion in 2027 to $81.3 billion in 2028, accounting for about 55% of the global market value.

Benefiting from both full‑rack and ASIC engines, AI servers are accelerating toward full‑rack systems. Nvidia's GB300 has moved its GPU tier to 800 Gb, with leaf and spine tiers adopting 1.6 Tb; Rubin and Rubin Ultra are continuing the shift to 1.6 Tb and 3.2 Tb. Global AI full‑rack shipments are projected to grow from 19,000 units in 2025 to 55,000 in 2026, 105,000 in 2027 and 163,000 in 2028.
At the same time, ASICs are expected to account for 50% of the global AI chip market in 2026, rising to 55% by 2028, with their optical interconnect demand comparable to that of GPU systems.

Goldman also raised the per‑chip optical module count for AI chips: Rubin Ultra’s 1.6 Tb count per GPU jumps from 0 to 2 and its 3.2 Tb count from 3 to 5; Google’s TPU v9 will use 12 units of 1.6 Tb per chip in the second half of 2027 through the first half of 2028, and 6 units of 3.2 Tb in the second half of 2028.

On the cost side, a 1.6 Tb silicon photonic module uses four 70 mW continuous‑wave lasers and costs $15‑$20, far below the roughly $160 price of an EML solution. Goldman expects silicon photonics penetration of about 60% for 800 Gb, and around 80% for 1.6 Tb and 3.2 Tb. CPO remains early‑stage, with shipments of 720 k, 8.53 M and 16.25 M units in 2026‑2028, corresponding to penetration rates of 1%, 6% and 9%. Notably, Goldman cut its 2026 forecast by 33% while raising the 2028 outlook by 105%.

Furthermore, although prices for 800 Gb and 1.6 Tb products of the same generation decline year over year, the rising share of high‑speed products will lift the industry‑wide average price from $123 to $190 and $204 respectively.
Currently, Goldman Sachs assigns a "Buy" rating to optical module and engine manufacturers Zhongji Xuchuang, FOCI, LandMark, VPEC, and equipment maker Lumentum.

items.title: 蘋果採用中國記憶體要成真？長鑫科技發表聲明釋訊號
items.title_en: Apple's Use of Chinese Memory Chips Could Become Reality? ChangXin Technology Issues Statement
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US) 與中國記憶體大廠長鑫科技(688825-CN) 的合作談判近期再度釋出正面訊號，長鑫科技最新表態願與全球頂級客戶探索合作機會，使外界因此認為，雙方合作案可能逐步走向明朗。不過，若蘋果與中國記憶體業者建立合作關係，也可能使其在美國面臨更大的政治敏感度。
根據《Wccftech》報導，蘋果近期正尋求增加記憶體供應端的議價空間，除了美光科技(MU-US) 、三星電子(005930KS) 、SK海力士(000660KS) 及鎧俠（Kioxia）等主要記憶體供應商外，長鑫科技也成為潛在合作對象。
另一方面，美國政府據報也可能將蘋果與長鑫科技的潛在合作，視為與中國進行談判時可運用的籌碼。美國總統川普與中國國家主席習近平預計於本月底訪美期間接觸，在此背景下，相關合作案也受到關注。
長鑫科技近期針對與蘋果的談判釋出最新訊號，表示：「我們對於與全球頂尖客戶探索合作機會持開放態度。目前，我們的產品在效能、品質及供應可靠度方面，已具備與全球領先供應商競爭的能力。」
長鑫科技目前正積極擴充產能，預計今年底前透過3座300mm晶圓廠，將月產能提升至約30萬片，平均每座晶圓廠月產能約10萬片。
此外，公司也正擴充以高頻寬記憶體（HBM）為重點的產能，預計到2026年底達到每月約5萬片。
長鑫科技同時在上海及合肥興建兩座新晶圓廠，完成後將進一步推升整體月產能至60萬片。按照目前擴產進度，長鑫科技預計最快在2030年超越美光的量產規模。
除了擴大產能，長鑫科技的記憶體技術也持續提升。目前公司已進入LPDDR5X量產階段，並開始生產LPDDR6，另外也計畫在今年稍晚啟動HBM3量產。
在製程微縮面臨限制的情況下，長鑫科技據報也開始採用高介電常數金屬閘極（High-k Metal Gate，HKMG）技術，以氧化鉿（HfO₂）等材料取代傳統矽基絕緣層。這項技術可降低漏電流及相關熱能損耗，同時提升能源使用效率，並為更高運算速度提供條件。
儘管長鑫科技持續擴大產能並提升技術能力，但蘋果若最終與其合作，預計也不會完全依賴長鑫科技供應中國市場所需的記憶體。
目前估計，蘋果與中國市場相關的記憶體需求約達6億GB，計算基礎為每年約5000萬支裝置、平均每支使用12GB記憶體。
考慮到長鑫科技目前產能已排滿至2027年，且產能利用率約達95%，蘋果可能僅會透過長鑫科技滿足部分中國市場的記憶體需求。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) and Chinese memory giant ChangXin Technology (688825-CN) have recently signaled positive developments in their cooperation talks, with ChangXin stating its willingness to explore opportunities with top global customers, leading observers to believe the deal may be gradually clarifying. However, a partnership between Apple and a Chinese memory supplier could increase political sensitivity for Apple in the United States.

According to a report by Wccftech, Apple is currently seeking to expand its bargaining power on the memory supply side. In addition to major memory suppliers Micron (MU-US), Samsung Electronics (005930KS), SK Hynix (000660KS) and Kioxia, ChangXin Technology has also emerged as a potential partner.

On the other hand, U.S. officials are reported to be considering Apple’s potential collaboration with ChangXin as a bargaining chip in negotiations with China. President Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping are expected to meet during a visit to the United States at the end of the month, bringing the prospective deal into focus.

ChangXin recently issued a fresh signal regarding talks with Apple, saying: “We are open to exploring cooperation opportunities with top global customers. Our products now match leading suppliers worldwide in performance, quality and supply reliability.”

ChangXin is actively expanding capacity and expects to boost monthly output to roughly 300,000 wafers by the end of the year through three new 300‑mm fabs, averaging about 100,000 wafers per plant per month.
The company is also scaling up production focused on high‑bandwidth memory (HBM), aiming for about 50,000 wafers per month by the end of 2026.

ChangXin is building two additional fabs in Shanghai and Hefei; once completed, total monthly capacity will rise to 600,000 wafers, and at the current expansion pace the firm could surpass Micron’s production scale as early as 2030.
Beyond capacity growth, ChangXin’s memory technology continues to advance. It has entered mass production of LPDDR5X, begun manufacturing LPDDR6, and plans to start HBM3 production later this year.

Facing limits to process scaling, ChangXin is reportedly adopting High‑k Metal Gate (HKMG) technology, using materials such as hafnium oxide (HfO₂) instead of traditional silicon‑based dielectrics. This reduces leakage current and thermal loss, improves energy efficiency and supports higher computing speeds.
Even if Apple ultimately partners with ChangXin, analysts expect Apple will not rely exclusively on the Chinese supplier for the memory needed in the Chinese market.
Apple’s memory demand for the Chinese market is estimated at about 600 million GB, based on roughly 50 million devices per year each using an average of 12 GB of memory.
Given that ChangXin’s capacity is already booked through 2027 and utilization sits around 95%, Apple is likely to source only a portion of its Chinese‑market memory needs from ChangXin.

items.title: 佈局矽光代工！三星電子使用跟台積電同款測試設備做矽光PIC驗證台
items.title_en: Samsung Deploys Silicon Photonics Foundry! Samsung Uses Same Test Equipment as TSMC for Silicon Photonic PIC Verification
paras: 最新報導指出，南韓三星電子已選定與台積電相同的FormFactor與旺矽(MPI)探針台，開展矽光用光集成晶片(PIC)晶圓測試，藉此驗證光元件的電-光訊號轉換效能。上述兩家探針台廠商，先前均已通過台積電CPO測試設備的品質認證。
《財聞社》報導，三星去年仍將PIC晶圓驗證委託外部機構執行，如今已自建測試環境，並針對初代設計展開多輪評估，將結果回饋至設計端優化。
與此同時，三星正面向博通等潛在客戶推進評估準備，並打算在今年下半年啟動已取得訂單的大型光通訊模組廠商項目量產。
在完成PIC晶片測試後，三星擬將測試範圍進一步拓展至整合電子集成電路(EIC)與PIC的光引擎，新增時域測量，以驗證高速數據傳輸性能。光引擎預計今年啟動開發，2027年展開測試。
按照規劃，三星將自2027年起正式對外提供矽光代工服務，輸出光元件工藝、光元件庫及工藝設計套件(PDK)，最終構想是將光引擎與邏輯晶片、HBM共同封裝，並把CPO應用場景從網路交換機拓展至GPU、CPU等晶片領域。
業內人士認為，三星此舉意在補齊矽光測試與量產能力，正面切入AI算力驅動下快速擴張的CPO領域，能否如期在2027年落地代工服務，將決定三星在下一代光互連供應鏈中的話語權。
paras_en: The latest report indicates that South Korea's Samsung Electronics has selected the same FormFactor and MPI probe stations as TSMC to conduct wafer testing of silicon photonic integrated circuits (PICs), in order to verify the electro‑optical signal conversion performance of the optical components. Both probe‑station vendors have previously passed TSMC’s CPO test‑equipment quality certification.

According to a report by Finance News Society, Samsung last year still outsourced PIC wafer verification to external agencies; it has now built its own test environment and is conducting multiple rounds of evaluation on the first‑generation design, feeding the results back to the design team for optimization.

At the same time, Samsung is advancing evaluation preparations for potential customers such as Broadcom and plans to launch mass production for a large optical‑communication module maker that has already placed orders in the second half of this year.

After completing PIC chip testing, Samsung intends to expand the test scope to optical engines that integrate electronic integrated circuits (EIC) with PICs, adding time‑domain measurements to verify high‑speed data‑transfer performance. The optical engine development is slated to start this year, with testing to begin in 2027.

According to its roadmap, Samsung will officially offer silicon‑photonic foundry services to external customers starting in 2027, providing optical component processes, component libraries, and process design kits (PDKs). The ultimate vision is to co‑package optical engines with logic chips and HBM, extending CPO application scenarios from network switches to GPUs, CPUs and other chip domains.

Industry insiders believe Samsung’s move aims to fill gaps in silicon‑photonic testing and mass‑production capabilities, directly entering the rapidly expanding CPO market driven by AI compute power. Whether it can deliver foundry services as scheduled in 2027 will determine Samsung’s influence in the next‑generation optical interconnect supply chain.

items.title: 逼近今年新高！日元兌美元9月迄今強升3.8%  152成關鍵防線
items.title_en: Approaching This Year's New High! Yen Gains 3.8% Against the Dollar So Far in September, 152 as a Key Defense Line
paras: 日元兌美元匯率週二(8日)持續走升，一度升值0.5%至153.53，本月迄今累計升值近3.8%，為G10最強貨幣，目前交易員目標直指152區域。
日元持續走強，主要係因美國假期流動性偏薄，跌破155加速了原本看多行情，加上日本央行(BOJ)升息預期升溫、市場揣測GPIF調整資產配置，也提振日元。熟悉匯市交易人士指出，跌破155觸發止損，並迫使選擇權交易員拋售美元。
澳洲國民銀行策略師Rodrigo Catril表示，美元兌日元貶破155支撐「為進一步下行打開大門」，料將下探152.27與152.1前低，152.1則為今年最強支撐，技術指標亦指向152。
隨著波動加劇，套利交易平倉風險升溫。SMBC日興證券資深利率與外匯分析師丸山倫人(Rinto Maruyama)指出，若美元兌日圓貶破154，恐觸發更多平倉與止損，為日元持續升值留出空間，但也讓投資人有空間重建空單。
目前，市場關注周五(11日)公布的美國通膨數據、日本央行委員Kazuyuki Masu談話，以及下周央行會議。
隔夜指數掉期數據顯示，BOJ下周升息1碼機率達97%。Catril形容日元正處十字路口，升息是必要條件，但要維持聲勢，BOJ須釋出鷹派信號，並強化年底前再升息預期。
paras_en: The yen‑dollar exchange rate continued to rise on Tuesday (the 8th), at one point appreciating 0.5% to 153.53. It has gained nearly 3.8% so far this month, making it the strongest G10 currency, and traders are now targeting the 152 area.

The yen’s ongoing strength is mainly due to thin US holiday liquidity, which accelerated the bullish move after breaking below 155, combined with rising expectations of a BOJ rate hike and market speculation that the GPIF is adjusting its asset allocation, all of which have bolstered the yen. Experienced FX market participants note that breaking below 155 triggers stop‑loss orders and forces options traders to sell dollars.

ANZ strategist Rodrigo Catril said the dollar‑yen dip below the 155 support “opens the door for further downside,” forecasting a test of 152.27 and the previous low of 152.1, with 152.1 being the strongest support this year, and technical indicators also pointing to 152.

As volatility intensifies, the risk of arbitrage unwind rises. SMBC Nikko Securities senior rates and FX analyst Rinto Maruyama warned that if USD/JPY falls below 154, it could trigger additional unwindings and stop‑losses, leaving room for continued yen appreciation while also giving investors space to rebuild short positions.
The market is currently focused on Friday’s (the 11th) US inflation data release, remarks by BOJ board member Kazuyuki Masu, and next week’s central‑bank meetings.

Overnight index‑swap data show a 97% probability that the BOJ will raise rates by one basis point next week. Catril describes the yen as being at a crossroads; a rate hike is a necessary condition, but to maintain momentum the BOJ must issue hawkish signals and reinforce expectations of another hike before year‑end.

items.title: 美債再承壓！德銀：挪威主權財富基金料大舉調整配置策略 日元、日債最受益
items.title_en: US Treasuries Under Pressure Again! Deutsche Bank: Norwegian Sovereign Wealth Fund Likely to Make Major Allocation Shift, Yen and Japanese Bonds Benefit Most
paras: 德意志銀行最新表示，規模達2.2兆美元的挪威主權財富基金近日提議調整投資策略，恐導致對日本國債的配置大幅增加。
德銀外匯策略師Shreyas Gopal和George Saravelos在最新研究報告中寫道：「雖然涉及的金額相對於全球固定收益市場的規模較小，但我們認為，作為全球規模最大、最成功的主權財富基金之一，其投資策略變化有力地表明，當前全球資本流動和投資組合配置正在發生緩慢但持續的轉變。」
報告指出，挪威承認主權債務不再是無風險資產，並正將其美國固定收益資產配置從美債轉向非主權固定收益資產。
挪威主權財富基金也正在大幅轉向日本國債，進而「承認其市場規模龐大，並降低債務佔GDP比重作為市場配置指標的重要性」。
對此德銀認為，這種配置策略上的傾斜意味著受益最大的國家和貨幣是日元。
paras_en: Deutsche Bank recently stated that the Norwegian sovereign wealth fund, with a size of $2.2 trillion, has proposed adjusting its investment strategy, potentially leading to a significant increase in its allocation to Japanese government bonds.

In its latest research report, Deutsche Bank foreign‑exchange strategists Shreyas Gopal and George Saravelos wrote: "Although the amount involved is relatively small compared to the global fixed‑income market, we believe that as the world’s largest and most successful sovereign wealth fund, its shift in investment strategy strongly indicates that global capital flows and portfolio allocations are undergoing a slow but steady transformation."
The report notes that Norway acknowledges that sovereign debt is no longer risk‑free and is shifting its U.S. fixed‑income allocation from U.S. Treasuries to non‑sovereign fixed‑income assets.

The Norwegian sovereign wealth fund is also making a large shift toward Japanese government bonds, thereby "recognizing the vast market size and reducing the importance of debt-to‑GDP ratio as a key market allocation metric."
Deutsche Bank believes that this tilt in allocation strategy means that the country and currency that will benefit the most is the yen.

items.title: 【遠東商銀】多重因素推動，日圓大幅上漲
items.title_en: [Far East Commercial Bank] Multiple Factors Drive Yen Surge

items.title_en: EUR/USD: Euro Awaits ECB Rate Hike, Oil Near $100; Dollar Also Quiet
paras: 要點：

歐元在1.16美元附近持穩
交易員關注ECB升息
油價為整體市場情緒帶來壓力


歐洲的能源衝擊顯示，週四可能需要採取更緊縮的貨幣政策。強勁的美國非農就業數據也重新點燃了市場對聯準會升息的預期。

歐元在週四利率決議前維持穩定


週一，EURUSD維持在1.16美元附近，儘管全球利率預期出現大幅重新定價，歐元仍沒有太大波動。
貨幣對的平靜走勢反映多股力量的拉鋸：市場預期歐洲央行本週升息，可能支撐歐元；另一方面，週五強勁的美國就業數據則強化了美元的殖利率優勢。
市場普遍預期ECB將於週四把存款利率上調25個基點至2.50%。這將是自6月政策制定者開始因應能源推動的通膨以來，第二次升息。
歐元區8月通膨率從2.9% 加速至3.3%，主要受到能源價格上漲推動。排除波動較大的食品與燃料價格後，核心通膨率則降至2.4%。


油價讓 ECB 的政策訊息更加複雜


週末美國與伊朗在荷姆茲海峽附近攻擊船隻後，布蘭特原油價格一度逼近97美元。途經該航線的航運量大幅下降，增加長期運輸中斷的風險。
歐洲高度依賴能源進口，因此高油價對當地家庭與企業尤其不利。
升息決策本身可能已幾乎完全反映在市場價格中，因此歐元更大的反應可能來自Christine Lagarde的政策指引。
偏鷹派的政策展望 — 也就是暗示利率可能進一步上升的措辭 — 可能推高歐洲債券殖利率並支撐歐元。相反地，若釋放出謹慎的「升息一次就結束」訊息，可能使歐元走弱。


CPI 決定美元的下一步


在大西洋彼岸，美國8月新增162,000個工作職位，接近市場預期56,000個的三倍，而失業率維持在4.1%。交易員目前認為聯準會下週升息的機率約為57%。
美國生產者物價指數（PPI）將於週四公佈，消費者物價指數（CPI）則於週五公佈。若通膨數據偏高，將強化聯準會升息的理由，可能推動歐元兌美元跌破1.16美元，進一步測試1.1550與1.1500附近的支撐。
若通膨數據低於預期，則可能挑戰美元多頭，讓該貨幣對再次測試1.1660–1.1700。值得注意的是，儘管非農就業數據強勁、升息預期升溫，美元週一的漲幅仍然有限。
美國財政疑慮，以及海灣地區衝突可能帶來的通膨影響，似乎正在限制美元的需求。即使週一美國民眾放假休市，市場也早已很難再享受平靜的數據日曆。

paras_en: Key points: Euro holds near $1.16, traders watch for an ECB rate hike, and oil prices pressure overall market sentiment. Europe’s energy shock suggests tighter monetary policy may be needed on Thursday, while strong U.S. non‑farm payroll data reignites expectations of a Fed rate hike.

The euro remained stable around $1.16 on Thursday ahead of the rate decision. Despite a major repricing of global rate expectations, the EUR/USD pair showed little movement. The calm price action reflects a tug‑of‑war: markets expect the European Central Bank to raise rates this week, which could support the euro, while Friday’s strong U.S. jobs data bolsters the dollar’s yield advantage. The consensus is that the ECB will lift the deposit rate by 25 basis points to 2.50% on Thursday – the second hike since policymakers began reacting to energy‑driven inflation in June. Euro‑area inflation accelerated from 2.9% to 3.3% in August, driven mainly by higher energy prices, while core inflation (excluding volatile food and fuel) fell to 2.4%.

Oil prices add complexity to the ECB’s policy signal. After U.S. and Iranian attacks on vessels near the Hormuz Strait over the weekend, Brent crude briefly approached $97 per barrel, and shipping traffic through the strait has sharply declined, raising the risk of prolonged transport disruptions. Europe’s heavy reliance on imported energy makes high oil prices especially harmful to households and businesses. The rate‑rise decision itself is likely already priced in, so the euro’s next move may hinge on Christine Lagarde’s guidance. A more hawkish outlook – hinting further rate hikes – could push European bond yields higher and support the euro, whereas a cautious “one‑time hike only” message could weaken it. In the U.S., August added 162,000 jobs, nearly three times the 56,000 forecast, with unemployment steady at 4.1%. Traders see about a 57% chance of a Fed hike next week. The PPI is due Thursday and CPI on Friday; higher‑than‑expected inflation would reinforce a Fed hike, potentially pulling EUR/USD below 1.16 and testing support around 1.1550‑1.1500. Lower inflation could challenge the dollar’s rally and let the pair retest 1.1660‑1.1700. Despite strong payrolls and rising rate‑hike expectations, the dollar’s gain on Monday was modest. Fiscal concerns in the U.S. and inflation risks from Middle‑East conflicts appear to be capping dollar demand, and even with a U.S. holiday, markets are finding it hard to enjoy a quiet data calendar.

items.title: 升息預期+交易量萎縮 日元強升創下半年新高
items.title_en: Rate‑Hike Expectations and Shrinking Trading Volume Push Yen to Half‑Year High
paras: 日元兌美元匯率周一(7日)強漲，急升至半年多以來新高，領漲非美貨幣。
交易數據顯示，日元兌美元匯率周一一度擴大漲幅達 1.4%，最高升至 154.06，創下自 2026 年 2 月 23 日以來的最強紀錄，並成功衝破 155 這一關鍵防線。由於美國適逢勞動節假期休市，全球交易量顯著萎縮，清淡的市況進一步放大了匯率的波動，使得短線走勢更為劇烈。
推動此輪日元反彈的核心動力，在於市場對日本央行(BOJ)將採取更積極貨幣政策的強烈預期。 市場目前高度聚焦 9 月 18 日的日銀利率決策，積極押注日銀屆時將升息 25 個基點。日本央行審議委員高田創先前的發言更助長了升息情緒，他透露連續升息不無可能。
此外，日本政府年金投資基金(GPIF)可能調整資產配置的傳聞、月初實質資金的常態性重新配置，以及原油價格下跌改善日本貿易條件，皆為日元提供了關鍵支持。
技術面上，日元成功突破 155 心理關卡，被視為多空逆轉的重要信號。 投資機構 State Street 策略師 Loo 指出，155 關卡在過去官方干預時曾作為日元底部的「地板」，破位極具指標性。一旦匯價衝破該關卡，隨即觸發了下方龐大的止損單，迫使期權交易商拋售美元，進而加劇日元漲幅。
三菱日聯信託銀行外匯交易主管Motonari Sakai表示，若日元升破 154 低點，下一個目標恐將直指 152 日元區間。
與此同時，日本官方先前為了捍衛日元所付出的巨額代價也隨之曝光。日本財務省最新數據揭露，截至 8 月底，日本持有的外國證券頭寸創紀錄地暴跌了 878 億美元，直接用於資助近期干預。在截至 8 月 26 日的一整個月內，東京當局共砸下創紀錄的 15.4 兆日元(約合 98.6 億美元)支持本國貨幣。
儘管日元上周已升值 2.4%，日本最高外匯官員三村淳強調防守姿態並未改變。Russell Investments 策略主管 Van Luu 分析指出，此輪上漲更多是由市場「有機」驅動，顯得更有意義。
paras_en: The yen surged against the dollar on Monday (the 7th), jumping to a new high not seen in more than six months and leading the rally among non‑U.S. currencies.

Trading data showed the yen‑dollar pair briefly expanded its gain to 1.4% on Monday, peaking at 154.06 – the strongest level since February 23, 2026 – and successfully breaking the critical 155 barrier. Because the United States was closed for the Labor Day holiday, global trading volume contracted sharply, and the thin market amplified the exchange‑rate swings, making the short‑term move even more volatile.

The core driver of this yen rebound is the market’s strong expectation that the Bank of Japan (BOJ) will adopt a more aggressive monetary policy. Market participants are now focused on the BOJ’s rate decision on September 18 and are betting that the central bank will raise rates by 25 basis points. Comments earlier from BOJ policy‑maker Takata Sōsen, who said a series of hikes is not out of the question, further fueled the rate‑hike sentiment.

In addition, rumours that the Government Pension Investment Fund (GPIF) may rebalance its asset allocation, routine re‑allocation of real funds at the start of the month, and lower oil prices improving Japan’s trade conditions have all provided key support for the yen.

On the technical side, the yen’s break above the 155 psychological level is seen as an important signal of a bullish reversal. State Street strategist Loo noted that the 155 mark has historically acted as a “floor” during official interventions, so a break is highly indicative. Once the price pierced that level, a large wave of stop‑loss orders below was triggered, forcing options dealers to sell dollars and further accelerating the yen’s rise.
Mitsubishi UFJ Trust Bank’s FX trading head Motonari Sakai said that if the yen clears the 154 low, the next target could be the 152‑yen range.

At the same time, the huge cost Japan has incurred to defend the yen has been disclosed. Ministry of Finance data show that by the end of August, Japan’s foreign‑securities holdings had plunged by a record $87.8 billion, directly used to fund recent interventions. Over the full month ending August 26, Tokyo authorities spent a record ¥15.4 trillion (about $9.86 billion) to support the domestic currency.

Although the yen appreciated 2.4% last week, Japan’s top foreign‑exchange official Jun Mimura stressed that the defensive stance has not changed. Russell Investments strategy head Van Luu argued that this rally is largely “organic” market‑driven, making it more meaningful.
